I've prepared a briefing to get you caught up.|Ahsoka Tano, and Hera Syndulla|{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}}}} [[File:Hera_debriefing.png|left|thumb|250x250px|Hera Syndulla met with Ahsoka Tano aboard ''Home One'']] At some point, Syndulla and Chopper ventured to [[Black Spire Outpost]]{{Twitter|starwars|status/1700216005216317539|''[[Star Wars]]''|quote=space mom has arrived Meet Hera Syndulla for a limited-time in Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge® at the @Disneyland Resort.}} on the planet''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Batuu]]. In [[9 ABY]],{{AhsokaDate|1}} General Syndulla arrived on ''[[Home One]]'' to meet with Ahsoka Tano. One of the ships in the fleet's rendezvous had been boarded by two lightsaber-wielding foes, its crew slaughtered to a man. [[Morgan Elsbeth]], a prisoner that they ship had been carrying, was stolen and the ship scuttled. Her and Ahsoka met on ''Home One'' to debrief the situation. Hera recalled that it was almost like old times in the Rebellion. Both of them discussed the situation with the missing prisoner and the starmap that Ahsoka had gathered. The former Jedi explained that Thrawn's return could lead to a massive revival in military power for the [[Imperial Remnant|Imperial Remnants]] and warlords that scattered the galaxy. System after system could fall to a fresh Imperial counterattack led by one of the greatest military minds to ever exist. Hera suggested that she seek out Sabine Wren on Lothal for a possible apprenticeship and to help her track down Ezra Bridger. =====Speaking with Tano===== {{Quote|I just wish she had changed a little. But she's still just as stubborn and bullish as ever.''"
"''She's Mandalorian. You knew what you were getting into.''"
"''I thought I did.|Ahsoka Tano and Hera Syndulla|{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}}}} Ahsoka contacted her after meeting with Sabine Wren several days later, concerned that this was maybe a mistake. Sabine had run off with the starmap after the former Jedi had explicitly told her not to leave. Hera insisted on Sabine's behalf, saying that if anyone knew how to find Ezra, it would be Sabine. Hera would be proved right shortly after. However, Sabine was shortly attacked by several [[HK-87 assassin droid]]s and a dark side force user. In the ensuing melee, Sabine was heavily wounded and the starmap lost. Hera was notified via hologram about the stolen map. =====Corellian Shipyard Investigation===== {{Quote|What a mess? How can they still be loyal to the Empire?''"
"''It's not loyalty. It's greed.|Hera Syndulla and Ahsoka Tano|{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}} }} [[File:AhsokaChopperHera-Ahsoka-PartTwo.png|thumb|right|250px|Hera and Chopper met with Ahsoka on Corellia]] Ahsoka Tano went on a mission after Sabine had managed to activate the memory circuit of one of the assassin droids. Hera and Ahsoka left for [[Corellia]]'s [[Facility 301G|shipyards]] after realizing that Morgan Elsbeth had owned manufacturing plants there. Hera met with one of the Regional Supervisors, [[Myn Weaver]], to discuss possible Imperial remnant activity. Weaver stated that he was particularly busy at the moment, but Syndulla pressed him, stating that this would be a far more formal investigation if she could not do so immediately. Weaver took them on a [[REV-2K personnel carrier]] through the production plant, telling them the insides of his operation. During the ride, he was questioned on the loyalty of his workers (most of them had been employed by the Empire) to which he replied that average workers did not care about galactic politics. After this, Hera suggested that Tano take Sabine back on as an apprentice. Tano replied that neither of them was ready for that. Still, Hera believed it would be good for both of them, saying that Wren needed some structure in her life and so did Tano. Once Myn Weaver showed them into the control center, Tano asked about the purpose and clients of the manufacturing center. While Weaver was explaining the priority given to shareholders, Hera spotted a massive hyperdrive core. Weaver explained that it had been extracted from a [[Super Star Destroyer]]. Hera was befuddled since the New Republic had not been constructing anything of that size. Weaver checked the logs and explained that it was of a classified nature and that it needed approval before he could unseal it. The supervisor asked for the protocol droid [[C1-D1]] to explain the regulation surrounding it. Tano questioned him on the other types of droids in use, but the protocol droid interjected by stating that she had been interrupted by an HK earlier. The protocol droid stated that it was on the transport about to leave with the massive hyperspace core. Hera ordered the flight crew to stop the ship from leaving the planet, but the crew, and even Myn Weaver, had actually been Imperial loyalists the entire time. Several drew pistols in an attempt to kill the general, but Tano's lightning-fast reflexes had dispatched all of them in seconds. Hera rushed to the ''Phantom II'' to stop the transport as soon as possible. Tano leaped out of the window, sprinting towards the rapidly ascending transport, but an assassin droid and a former Imperial Inquisitor named [[Marrok]], who was working for Elsbeth as a mercenary, stood in her way. Meanwhile, Chopper and Hera had launched the ship and ordered the transport to stand down. The transport crew was not particularly excited about this news, as they instantly opened fire. Hera could not simply shoot the ship down and crash it into the city below, but she also could not simply let it escape either. Hera sped the ''Phantom II'' straight toward the escaping transport, and Chopper chucked a tracking device onto it right before it launched into hyperspace. Tano had dueled the two Imperials, destroying the HK droid and forcing the Force wielder to escape onto a shuttle that had almost blasted the former Jedi to death. After this, both of them watched over as dozens of Imperial spies and Weaver were arrested by New Republic security forces. Tano stated that it wasn't simply loyalty that drove them, it was greed. Hera stayed back on Corellia as Tano took her ship back to Lothal to meet up with Sabine. Then, the new apprentice joined her master in tracking the Imperials. ====Meeting with the Chancellor==== [[File:HamatoZiono-RFGE.png|thumb|left|250px|Syndulla had an antagonistic relationship with Senator Hamato Xiono.]] {{Quote|Did you ever fight in the war senator?|Hera Syndulla, to Xiono|{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}}}} After the events on Corellia, Syndulla returned to Home One for a discussion with New Republic Senators, leaving her son, Jacen, to play with Chopper. Chancellor Mothma greeted the general, but Senator Hamato Xiono interrupted Syndulla's response, stating that they should begin immediately due to a lack of time. Syndulla reported the events on Corellia and linked them to the rumors regarding Thrawn's return. A surprised Mothma questioned the possibility, before Xiono suggested that Syndulla was wasting resources to give in to her personal feelings. The two exchanged subtle insults before Syndulla publicly questioned Xionos' integrity for being absent throughout the war. As a result, her request was denied, which she reported back to Tano. ====Unauthorized mission to Seatos==== Knowing full well that Ahsoka and Wren would not endanger themselves chasing mere rumors, Hera took the ''Ghost,'' Jacen, Chopper, and a squadron of X-Wings with her to Seatos to ascertain the truth herself. [[Carson Teva]] joined her on the mission. By the time they arrived to the system, they witnessed the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'' about to jump to hyperspace, right in front of them. Unable to stop the hyperspace ring in time, the squadron took evasive action, but a few of them were destroyed as the Eye jumped.{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}} Landing on the surface of an altar, Hera was able to determine that a battle had taken place there, but both Ahsoka and Wren were nowhere to be seen. The only things she was able to recover were the remains of the Star Map and Wren's helmet. However, Jacen was able to hear something in the waves. He called out to Hera to listen as well. At first, Hera heard nothing, but as Jacen insisted, he heard lightsaber crackling. Hera listened more closely and also heard it faintly. She ordered Carson to sweep the nearby area and the ocean. After multiple sweeps, the squadron still found nothing until Hera told Chopper to scan. Chopper was eventually able to pick up something with Jacen's direction, and eventually, Hera was able to extract Ahsoka from the ocean, injured but alive. After Ahsoka recovered, she briefed Hera about what had happened; she and Wren attempted to stop Morgan Elsbeth, but as she tried to grab the map, her hand was burned, and Baylan Skoll pushed her down from the cliff. She had urged Wren to destroy the map, but apparently she did not, which allowed the ''Eye of Sion'' to leave. Both women believed that Sabine is alive, but they had no way to follow her, until Ahsoka came up with the idea to ask purrgils to follow the Eye. Hera and Jacen watched as Ahsoka talked with purrgils with the Force. Just then, the New Republic fleet arrived to investigate Hera's actions. Hera told Carson to stall them until Ahsoka can get the purrgils to take her. This worked and purrgils began to head towards the coordinates, where the Eye had jumped earlier. The fleet was forced to move out of the way. Hera wished Ahsoka good luck as she promised to find Sabine and Ezra. [[File:ThreepioTevaSyndullaCourt-Ahsoka-PartSeven.png|thumb|right|250px|On behalf of Leia Organa, C-3PO acquitted Hera of her charges in court]] Following Seatos, Hera was brought to Coruscant,{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}} the governmental center for the New Republic,''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' to answer for her actions in front of a court headed by Mon Mothma and Senator Xiono. Xiono was more than willing to strip Hera of command and imprison her. Even Carson Teva's claim that the Imperial Remnants were up to something based on Moff Gideon's actions on Mandalore was ignored. But thanks to C-3PO, who interceded on behalf of Senator Leia Organa, Hera was acquitted of all charges. Mon Mothma then talked with Hera and asked how real the return of Thrawn was. Hera said they must hope for the best and prepare for the worst. ====Reuniting with an old friend==== Some time after the trial, Hera was back at Home One when a shuttle was escorted into its hangar. Gathering an armed welcoming party, the shuttle's bay door opened, and from it, a single stormtrooper emerged with his hands up. Hera and her party raised their weapons towards the trooper, but Chopper noticed something familiar about the trooper. He went to him, and the trooper placed his hand on the droid. The trooper then took off his helmet and revealed himself to be Ezra Bridger in disguise. Hera was utterly shocked to see him again after so long.{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} ===Legacy=== {{Quote|The Hera Syndulla? If only they had known where she'd end up.|Leia Organa|}} [[File:Spectres_painting.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Spectres depicted by Sabine's mural]] Sometime after the Battle of Endor, Sabine Wren painted a mural depicting Hera and the other Spectres flanked by loth-wolves and loth-cats to honor their role in the Rebellion. When ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' were [[Excavation on Durkteel|recovered]] by the [[Resistance]] in [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' establishes that ''[[The Rebel Files]]'' were [[Bombardment of Durkteel|buried]] on [[Durkteel]] at the same [[time]] as the [[Battle of Endor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]]. As the book also states that the files had not been seen for thirty [[Standard year|years]] prior to their recovery, the [[excavation on Durkteel]] and the case's journey from Durkteel to [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] must have taken place in [[34 ABY]]. Leia Organa, now a general in the Resistance, came across Ahsoka Tano's message to General [[Davits Draven]] following the Spectres' action at Mustafar. In the message, Tano informed Draven that Syndulla had received an Alliance officer's commission in the aftermath of the mission. Organa left a note asking if it referred to the Hera Syndulla, before she added if only Tano and Draven had known as the time where Syndulla would end up, a general in the New Republic. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|There's enough darkness in the galaxy right now. Let me know if you want to spread a little light.|Hera Syndulla|[[Star Wars: Outer Rim|''Star Wars'': Outer Rim]]}} [[File:HeraSyndulla1-Fathead.png|thumb|left|344x344px|Hera Syndulla and her blaster.]] Hera's personality was somewhat two-sided; while she exuded a no-nonsense style of command, she was also known for being a very warm and compassionate individual. As a highly capable pilot and captain, Hera took good care of her ship, as well as her crew. Upon meeting Ezra, Hera developed a sort of motherly bond with the boy as she had with the other crew members. She was a true believer in the rebel cause and inspired hope in the rest of the crew. She was also the only other crew member aware of Kanan's test after Ezra stole the latter's [[holocron]]. Hera was also in love with Kanan,{{WebCite|url=http://www.comingsoon.net/tv/features/620441-star-wars-rebels-cast-and-crew-talk-season-2-and-clone-wars-connections|text=Star Wars Rebels Cast and Crew Talk Season 2 and Clone Wars Connections|author=Busch, Jenna|date=2015-10-07|quote=Though Hera loves him very much, she knows she can't allow that part of him to step in front of that Galactic obligation she has to people everywhere.|archivedate=20170711093531}} she usually confided in him and frequently called him "love." She was more than capable of putting her foot down when she saw conflict within the crew, such as sending Ezra and Zeb out on an errand together when the two had been fighting. While an adept fighter, Hera also cared for her crew and knew how to motivate them to reach a common goal. A smart, tactful, and highly observant individual, Hera could quickly detect a threat. As Lando Calrissian successfully played her crew members off one another to his own ends, Hera caught on to his trickery and put the con-man in his place. Her skills of deduction proved invaluable when her suspicions of Gall Trayvis allowed her to expose the man as an Imperial agent. She also remembered when the Jedi and clones fought in the Clone Wars, at one point being saved from death by them, and encouraged Kanan to trust Captain Rex and put aside his past animosity towards clones. As with other Twi'lek females, many considered her attractive, particularly Kanan but also less savory characters as well, including Okadiah Garson, Azmorigan, and Lando Calrissian. She knew how to use her natural charm and beauty to her advantage when necessary, as seen when she manipulated the gangster Azmorigan in order to escape his ship. Due to her negative experiences with the criminals Azmorigan and Hondo, Hera was reluctant to work with them until Hondo convinced her that doing so would benefit the rebellion's interests. She despised their company to the extent that she ordered them to leave the ship once both parties had achieved their objectives. Despite her love for Kanan, Hera was deeply committed to the rebel cause. Her pragmatism led her to accede to Ahsoka Tano's advice that they not rescue him in order to avoid exposing the rebellion to the Empire, and was a key organizer of the early Alliance, whose original goal was to seek a diplomatic solution.''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' While Hera was angered that her crew had disobeyed her orders by embarking on a search for Kanan, she was mollified when Ezra revealed that he had a plan. She also viewed the rebel struggle as a larger galactic-wide struggle that went beyond the planet Lothal. Her concern for the galaxy put her at odds with her father, who was solely focused on achieving Ryloth's freedom. Despite their differences, she managed to convince her father and his rebel cell to help her crew to steal an Imperial fighter-carrier. [[File:HeraSyndullaWantedPoster-SWCT.png|thumb|right|220px|Hera's Imperial wanted poster]] Hera also had a love for flying which resonated well with her leadership aspirations in the rebellion. Due to her role in obtaining a prototype [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter|B-wing starfighter]], Hera was promoted to Phoenix Leader. While Hera regarded the space-faring purrgil as a pest for endangering interstellar travel, she came to respect them after the purrgil helped the Spectres to raid a Mining Guild refueling station. Something visibly seen by the fact that she wore her flight jacket during her days as a general, Syndulla would never forget her roots as a pilot.{{InsiderCite|223|Launchpad}} Hera also had a relationship with the astromech droid Chopper which dated back to the Clone Wars. She adopted the droid after rescuing him from a downed Y-wing fighter. Hera cared for Chopper and looked after the outdated astromech droid. She understood [[binary]] and regarded Chopper as an indispensable member of her crew. While Hera was angry with Chopper for allowing himself to be distracted during a raid on a fuel depot, she was mollified after Chopper and his new-found friend AP-5 helped find the rebellion the site for a new base on the planet Atollon. Hera was also skilled at undercover work. She could also change her accent in order to conceal her identity. Hera also displayed considerable fortitude and defiance when being interrogated by Grand Admiral Thrawn. Her courage and willingness to infiltrate her former home to recover a family heirloom the Kalikori gained Thrawn's respect. Despite losing the Kalikori to Thrawn, Hera came to realize that her crew and her father were her family and more important than old heirlooms. Hera was willing to let go of the past if it meant furthering the rebel cause. Cognizant of the Empire's military capabilities, Hera tried unsuccessfully to convince Mart Mattin and his Iron Squadron to accompany them back to the rebel fleet. Later, Hera led a successful mission to rescue Mart from the Empire. Despite the disillusioned Imperial Agent Kallus' help in obtaining plans for Thrawn's TIE Defender initiative, Hera still distrusted the Imperial. She cautioned her comrades to be careful with him until they could verify his trustworthiness. Hera also cared for her rebel crew and held a maternal role in the group, becoming its "Space Mom." She was both tough and loving towards her fellow rebels, with Wren and Bridger both coming to her for advice, encouragement, and training.{{InsiderCite|221|Space Moms}} Jarrus and Syndulla raised Bridger from a young troublemaker into the man he became.{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-part-8-the-jedi-the-witch-and-the-warlord-highlights|text=''Ahsoka'' Analyzed: 7 Highlights from "Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord"}} She displayed maternal instincts when Ezra was tormented by Maul's visions. Hera wanted to abort her recon mission to Lothal but Kanan managed to convince her to proceed with the mission. Due to her close rapport with Sabine, Hera was privy to Sabine's doubts, fears, and troubled relationship with her family. Knowing that Sabine was a fearsome warrior and strong leader, Hera counseled Kanan not to hold back her training but to let her fully embrace the Darksaber's power. As a rebel leader, Hera was aware of Saw Gerrera's harsh methods; which caused her not to trust him fully. Still, she regarded him as being better than the Empire. Hera typically spoke in a colloquial [[The galaxy|Galactic]] accent but occasionally reverted to her native Rylothian accent. Hera was a brave and creative pilot who was willing to undertake difficult challenges including smuggling the rebel leader Mon Mothma through the dangerous Archeon pass. Hera also had a deep respect for Mon Mothma and the two women became friends. Hera respected Mothma for her outspoken criticism of the Empire and her long-term strategic vision for the rebellion. Mothma in return complimented Hera for her willingness to take dangerous risks and courageous leadership. [[File:Herra_and_C1-10P_Ally_Pack_art.png|thumb|left|250px|Hera shared a strong bond with Chopper.]] Hera had a strong bond with Chopper and sought revenge on the Imperial intelligence officers who had reprogrammed her droid into a double agent. This led her to destroy an entire IGV-55 surveillance vessel with all hands aboard. Hera was distraught when she thought that she had lost Chopper and expressed elation when he rebooted. Hera was a courageous and skilled military commander who cared for the well-being of the rebellion and had a good working relationship with her fellow commanders Sato and Dodonna. She was not intimidated by Grand Admiral Thrawn and refused to surrender. Hera loved Kanan and pleaded with him to come back safely after his unsuccessful mission to solicit Bendu's help against the Empire. At times, Hera's devotion to the rebellion led her to regard the Spectres as important assets of the Rebel Alliance. She regarded Kanan as her partner and companion. Hera distrusted Saw Gerrera for his aggressive and violent methods and expressed concern when Saw enlisted Ezra, Sabine, and Chopper on one of his operations. Like Ezra, Hera believed the Spectres had a special connection with Lothal and was willing to accept a dangerous mission there. Hera's romantic feelings for Kanan led them to share a passionate embrace while on an undercover mission on Lothal. As a passionate rebel leader, Hera successfully lobbied for the Rebel Alliance to take out the TIE/D Defender factories on Lothal and to aid the people of Lothal, who were suffering under Imperial oppression. Hera's fearlessness and devotion to the rebel cause led her to lead a strike attempt on Lothal's Imperial factories. Hera also cared for her subordinates and was willing to risk capture in order to ensure that her underlings Chopper and Mart Mattin escaped Imperial forces. Hera's iron resolve and fighting spirit enabled her to hold out against both Governor Pryce and Grand Admiral Thrawn during interrogation. After Kanan rescued her, Hera confided her feelings for Kanan. Hera was devastated by the death of her partner Kanan and initially blamed herself. However, Chopper helped her to realize the significance of Kanan's sacrifice. To honor his memory, she attached a piece of his Jedi holocron to her family heirloom, the Kalikori. Kanan's death led Hera to be more careful about the lives of her rebel cell members. Though Hera was frightened that the Emperor had taken an interest in the Lothal Jedi Temple, Zeb convinced her to persevere with the mission. Despite Kanan's death, Hera could still sense his comforting presence. Hera also used her persuasive communications skills to recruit several old friends of Ezra including Gregor, Wolffe, Hondo, Melch, and Ketsu Onyo into helping Ezra to liberate his homeworld of Lothal. Despite her initial misgivings about Hondo, she decided to trust his plan to latch onto an Imperial cargo ship in order to get the ''Ghost'' through the Imperial blockade above Lothal. As a result, Hera came to trust Hondo. After Ezra helped trap Governor Pryce, Hera praised Ezra for his victory. Respecting her as a leader and mother figure, Ezra recognized her and the other rebels' contributions to their victory. During the Liberation of Lothal, Hera showed leadership and resolve. She endorsed Sabine's plan to send rebel teams to reactivate the shield generators. Hera also respected Ezra's decision to leave and confront Grand Admiral Thrawn alone. Out of respect for Hera's leadership and motherly role, Ezra left a meiloorun fruit for her before departing into uncharted space with Thrawn. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|That was one of your better crashes.''"
"''Kanan Jarrus, you know I never crash. I have very—''"
"''Very exciting landings. Thanks for reminding me.|Kanan Jarrus and Hera Syndulla|}} [[File:Hera_Syndulla_EaW.png|thumb|right|250px|Hera's love of flying was evident in her skill as a pilot]] Besides being an able and effective leader, Hera was also an exceptionally skilled pilot. Hera first honed her skills as a rebel pilot during a relief mission to Ryloth following the failed assassination attempt on the Emperor and Lord Vader. She was able to fly various ships including the ''Ghost'', the ''Phantom'', a prototype B-wing starfighter, and a T-65B X-wing starfighter. Hera was also familiar with physical combat and once assaulted the gangster Azmorigan and one of his men. Later, she knocked out the Imperial agent Gall Trayvis in physical combat after tricking him into holding an unloaded blaster. As a seasoned rebel operative, Hera could tell when a blaster was unloaded. [[File:Hera_Syndulla-FA.png|thumb|left|200px|Captain Hera Syndulla]] While Hera was a capable fighter who could come up with ingenious escape plans, she was no match for the Force powers of the former Sith Lord Maul. Despite her strong will-power, Hera could not stop Maul from retrieving information on the location of Kanan Jarrus' holocron from her mind. As a seasoned rebel commander, Hera was familiar with various Imperial strategies and traps. Hera was also tech-savvy enough to close the ''Ghost''{{'s}} cargo hatch manually. She also used Chopper as a conduit to send reverse data feed to destroy an Imperial surveillance vessel. As a military commander, Hera knew how to study battle maps in order to devise strategies. Her skills as a pilot also allowed her to lead from the front in space battles. As a skilled pilot, Hera was able to evade Imperial fighters including TIE/D Defenders. She later used her engineering skills to help Sabine install a hyperdrive aboard Ryder Azadi's U-wing. On another occasion, she was able to escape Thrawn's forces by jumping into hyperspace while flying through an Imperial construction module. Hera later used her dogfighting skills to take out a TIE/D Defender Elite and an Imperial light cruiser. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|There are certain issues that I care very much about in my life, in terms of equality and representation and fighting for those who are marginalized, and speaking up for those who may have no voice. This character seemed to do that. There's also a part of me that loves to bring people together.|Vanessa Marshall on Hera Syndulla|{{SW|url=news/vanessa-marshall-interview-star-wars-the-bad-batch|text=Hera Flies Again: Vanessa Marshall on Returning as the High-Flying Pilot in ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch''}}}} Hera Syndulla was created for the animated series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' where she was voiced by [[Vanessa Marshall]].{{SWYouTube|RzopG0SGJYI|Meet Hera, the Pilot | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-meet-hera-the-pilot}} She was first revealed at the [[January]] [[2014]] [[Wikipedia:Nuremberg International Toy Fair|Nuremberg International Toy Fair]], where the character was included on the packaging of a [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] ''Rebels'' set.{{WebCite|url=http://www.groovebricks.com/lego-star-wars-rebels-sets-at-the-nuremberg-germany-toy-fair|text=LEGO Star Wars Rebels Sets At The Nuremberg Germany Toy Fair -- Groove Bricks|author=Tomás|date=2014-01-28|work=[http://www.groovebricks.com Groove Bricks]|archivedate=20181007012014}} A video properly introducing the character was released on [[February 20]], 2014. Prior to the series' debut episode "[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion|Spark of Rebellion]]" on [[September 26]], [[2014]],{{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-spark-of-rebellion-to-debut-early-on-watch-disney-xd|text=Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion to Debut Early on WATCH Disney XD}} she appeared in the prequel novel ''[[A New Dawn (novel)|A New Dawn]]'' by [[John Jackson Miller]]{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2014-star-wars-a-new-dawn-panel-liveblog|text=SDCC 2014: ''Star Wars: A New Dawn'' Panel – Liveblog}} and other media.''[[Chopper Saves the Day]]''''[[Rise of the Rebels]]'' ===Design=== The character was envisioned as the skilled pilot and a norturing heart of the team and like their mother. The design phase for ''Rebels'' began in early [[2013]]. According to [[Kilian Plunkett]], she was envisioned "from the beginning" as a Twi'lek wearing a flight suit. Various differnt designs of female Twi'lek, all adult with either green or blue skin,''[[The Art of Star Wars Rebels]]''{{SW|url=news/wondercon-2014-star-wars-rebels-panel-report|text=WonderCon 2014: ''Star Wars Rebels'' Panel Report}} were designed by [[Chris Glenn]] and [[Amy Beth Christenson]] and one design of a blue skinned younger Twi'lek girl was also designed. All of the designs featured her wearing flight goggles, which series creator [[Dave Filoni]] compared to those used during [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-costuming-101-hera-syndulla|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Costuming 101: Hera Syndulla}} Her final model was designed by Kilian Plunkett and finished on [[April 11]], [[2013]]. It used bright warm colors and the markings on her lekku head tails were meant to set her apart from other Twi'lek characters. A series of facial studies for her final design was also drawn by Plunkett and a maquette of her final head was created by [[Darren Marshall]].{{WebCite|url=https://dmarshallart.com/star-wars-rebels-season-1|text=Star Wars Rebels - Season 1|work=[[Darren Marshall]]'s website|archivedate=20251211062553}} According to the [[StarWars.com]] blogger [[James Burns]], Hera Syndulla was named after the ancient Greek goddess [[Wikipedia: Hera|Hera]], whose name means "protector." Hera was the wife and the sister of the Greek god [[Wikipedia:Zeus|Zeus]] and was the goddess of women, childbirth, and marriage. [[Simon Kinberg]] and [[Dave Filoni]] also confirmed that Hera and several other characters in the television series were named after historical and Biblical characters in order to give their names a sense of purpose and meaning that would reflect their characters.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-whats-in-a-name|text=''Star Wars Rebels'': What's in a Name?|nolive=1}} Hera shares a surname with Cham Syndulla, a Twi'lek character from the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Cham Syndulla was revealed to be her father on [[February 23]], [[2015]].{{RebelsRecon|AATSzoxTC1g|#1.13: Inside "Rebel Resolve" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-rebel-resolve}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:HeraBlue-ConceptArt.png|Early concept art of Hera Syndulla File:Hera-ConceptArt-ABC2.png|Concept art of Hera Syndulla by Amy Beth Christenson File:Hera-ConceptArt-ChrisGlenn.png|Concept art of Hera Syndulla by Chris Glenn File:Hera-ConceptArt-ABC.png|Concept art of Hera Syndulla by Amy Beth Christenson File:RebelsCrew-EarlierConceptArt-ArtofRebels.png|Concept art of the ''Ghost'' crew including of Hera Syndulla by Amy Beth Christenson File:Hera-FacialStudies-KilianPlunkett.png|Facial studies of Hera Syndulla by Kilian Plunkett |digital= |in-progress= }} ===Portrayal=== {{Quote|Initally, I auditioned for a secret project entitled 'Wolf.' I earned a call back where I met Dave Filoni for the first time, and then my life changed when I got the news that I was going to play Hera! She was described as a 'nurturing yet fierce leader,' who assembles a chosen family to fight for the cause.|Vanessa Marshall|{{InsiderCite|219|Day Wanna Wanga - The Tale of the Twi'leks}}}} [[File:VanessaMarshall.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Vanessa Marshall, Hera's voice actress]] Vanessa Marshall was originally called in for a voiceover audition for a project just called "Wolf". Based on the script's content she already suspected that it could be ''[[Star Wars]]'', but was only confirmed when she got a call back and saw a picture of a Twi'lek on the wall. She originally imagined that Hera would look more like actor [[Sigourney Weaver]], but was "thrilled" that she was a Twi'lek, especially because she wanted to fight the perception that the species were all mostly slave [[dancer]]s.{{InsiderCite|151|Hera: A New Breed of Hero|reprint=1}} The voice cast recorded their scripts as a group before the animation phase and had only seen mockups of their characters' designs. Videos of their recording sessions were used to inform the character's facial expressions and Sabine Wren's voice actor [[Tiya Sircar]] thought that Syndulla looked "an awful lot" like Marshall.{{InsiderCite|152|Mandalorian Graffiti: Tiya Sircar is Sabine Wren|reprint=1}} Hera did not speak with a Twi'lek ([[Wikipedia:French language|French]]) accent until the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|Season Two]] episode "[[Homecoming]]," in the scene where she argues with her father. When she auditioned for the role, Vanessa Marshall read Hera's dialogue with her own accent, before being asked if she could do it in a French accent. Marshall, who is fluent in French, responded she would, but the topic did not come up again, presumably as it was decided it would be hard for viewers to understand. Eventually, Dave Filoni emailed her asking if she ever thought Hera would use a Twi'lek accent if she returned to her homeworld: Marshall replied "Only if she was angry." She later likened it to "someone from [[Wikipedia:Tennessee|Tennessee]] or [[Wikipedia:Texas|Texas]], or something like that, when they get into an argument with their father, all of a sudden, they're a [[Wikipedia:Southern belle|Southern belle]]. It demonstrates a kind of vulnerability that goes straight to the core of who she is. Even in that moment, she can't undo that accent. But I think that's how much she loves him and yearns to connect with him, that she even lets that guard down to speak in their shared accent."{{WebCite|url=http://www.hypable.com/star-wars-rebels-2x16-vanessa-marshall-clip|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' 2×16: Vanessa Marshall previews Hera's "Homecoming" – plus exclusive clip!|author=Schick, Michal|date=2016-02-17|work=Hypable|archivedate=20170528184640}} ===Further appearances=== {{Quote|We had a blast dialing in the exact right amount of youth and accent for little Hera. It was a dream come true to finally explore her relationship with her mother. I also loved planting the seeds for her dreams and goals for her future.|Marshall on returning for ''The Bad Batch''|}} General Syndulla is name-dropped as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|easter egg]] in the [[2016]] live-action film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which Dave Filoni clarified was meant to be Hera (as opposed to her father), a reference to a forthcoming storyline.{{WebCite|url=http://ew.com/movies/rogue-one-rebels-references/rogue-one-and-rebels-6|text=See the 'Star Wars: Rebels' References in 'Rogue One'|author=Breznican, Anthony|date=2016-12-20|work=Entertainment Weekly|archivedate=20161222184651}} Marshall returned to portray the character in the [[2020]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]'', developed by [[Motive Studios]], where she also provided [[Wikipedia:Motion capture|motion capture]] work for the character.{{Twitter|vanmarshall|status/1312156766176571393|[[Vanessa Marshall]]|date=2020-10-03|quote=Grateful to confirm that I am voicing Hera in #StarWarsSquadrons! My first motion capture gig!}} A teenaged Hera Syndulla later appeared in the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' in [[2021]], where she was again voiced by Marshall. Hera's model for the series was designed by [[Chris Madden]] and finished on [[February 11]], [[2020]].{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/devils-deal-episode-guide|text="Devil's Deal" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} Marshall was first approached by the series' producers over email and asked if she wanted to return, but was only later further informed about the series. She then recorded her lines in either late 2020 or early 2021.{{WebCite|url=https://www.cnet.com/culture/entertainment/hera-syndulla-voice-in-star-wars-the-bad-batch-was-inspired-by-marvel|text=Hera Syndulla's voice in Star Wars: The Bad Batch was inspired by Marvel|author=Sean Keane|date=2021-07-15|work=''[[Wikipedia:CNET|CNET]]''|archivedate=20220527011044}} Marshall said that she highly enjoyed figuring out the "right amount" of youthfulness and French accent for Hera's voice and that it was "a dream come true" to explore Hera's relationship with her mother and that she loved to establish the basis for Hera's future dreams and goals. Marshall was also inspired by her earlier role as the [[Marvel Comics]]' character [[Wikipedia:Mary Jane Watson|Mary Jane Watson]] in the animated series ''[[Wikipedia:The Spectacular Spider-Man (TV series)|The Spectacular Spider-Man]]''. ===''Ahsoka''=== [[File:MaryElizabethWinstead.png|thumb|left|190px|Mary Elizabeth Winstead portrays Hera in the ''Ahsoka'' television series.]] [[Mary Elizabeth Winstead]] portrays Hera Syndulla in the [[2023]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''.{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-ahsoka-panel|text=SWCE 2023: 10 Things We Learned from the ''Ahsoka'' Panel}} The casting of Winstead was first reported in December 2022 and was formally confirmed at [[Celebration|''Star Wars'' Celebration]] in April 2023.{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/ahsoka-series-hera-syndulla-mary-elizabeth-winstead-cast|text=Mary Elizabeth Winstead Reportedly Cast as Hera Syndulla in 'Ahsoka' Series|author=Arezou Amin|date=2023-12-23|work=''[[Wikipedia:Collider (website)|Collider]]''|archivedate=20221224224936}} Concept art of Winstead as Syndulla was created by [[Brian Matyas]] in [[2021]][[Ahsoka 2|''Ahsoka'' 2]] Ahead of [[Ahsoka Season 2|''Ahsoka'' Season 2]], Winstead stated that she recieved more play within the season and remarked that was very fun.{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/ahsoka-season-2-update-mary-elizabeth-winstead|text=‘Ahsoka’ Star Drops Action-Packed Season 2 Update on the Hit Star Wars Series [Exclusive]|author=McPherson, Chris|date=2025-10-17|work=Collider|archivedate=20251019172915}} ===Non-canon history=== {{Quote|No, General Syndulla.|[[Rowan Freemaker/LEGO|Rowan Freemaker]] expresses surprise as he spots Hera Syndulla|{{FreemakerAdventures|Trouble on Tibalt}}}} [[File:Alliance_leadership_Freemakers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Hera and members of the Rebel Alliance in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures Season Two'']] Hera Syndulla appears in ''[[Angry Birds Star Wars II]]''. At one point, she and Sabine Wren rescued the street orphan Ezra Bridger from stormtroopers. They escaped from Agent Kallus, and Hera let Ezra join her crew aboard the ''Ghost''.''[[Angry Birds Star Wars II]]'' In the [[LEGO Star Wars Movie Short|''LEGO Star Wars Rebels Movie Shorts'']], Hera, Kanan, and Zeb were drinking in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina|Mos Eisley Cantina]] when Ezra called for a rescue from a Star Destroyer. Ezra then suggested they charge the Star Destroyer's bridge and hide behind it, and eventually the warship jumped to hyperspace.{{LegoMiniMovie|RUZ2y3uRaW8|Saving The Phantom}} At another time, the ''Ghost'' was damaged by a Star Destroyer, forcing it to go to a space station for repairs. "''And those who oppose it are more powerful than you'll ever be.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Maul|audio=ObiWan-Maul-DarkSide.flac|}} '''Obi-Wan Kenobi''' was a legendary [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Jedi Master]] who served on the [[Jedi High Council]] during the final [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Republic Era]]. As a [[High Jedi General]], Kenobi served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] that fought against the [[Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars]], and was nicknamed "'''the Negotiator'''." Kenobi, however, was forced into [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] as a result of the [[Great Jedi Purge]] initiated by the Republic's own [[clone trooper]]s when Republic [[Supreme Chancellor]], secretly [[Darth Sidious]], implemented [[Order 66]]. As a mentor, Kenobi was responsible for [[Jedi training|training]] two members of the [[Skywalker family]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Anakin]] and [[Luke Skywalker]], both of whom served in turn as his [[Padawan]] in the ways of [[the Force]]. Kenobi was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Stewjon]] in [[57 BBY]]. He was Force-sensitive, and therefore taken from [[Kenobi family|his family]] and [[Jedi Initiate|inducted]] into the [[Jedi Order]] as a [[Youngling|child]]. Raised in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Grand Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant]], Kenobi was assigned to [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]]. In [[32 BBY]], Kenobi attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight]] by [[Battle of Naboo|defeating]] the [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul|Darth Maul]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. He also chose to train Anakin Skywalker—the prophesied [[Chosen One]] who was destined to destroy the [[Sith]] and restore balance to the Force—having promised Jinn who [[Death|died]] in the [[lightsaber duel]] against Maul. With the [[First Battle of Geonosis|advent]] of the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars in [[22 BBY]], Kenobi adopted the [[military rank]] of High Jedi General in the Grand [[Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], and was given command of the [[Open Circle Fleet]], the [[Third Systems Army]], and the [[7th Sky Corps]]. [[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody]] served as his second-in-command throughout [[the galaxy]]-wide conflict, with their forces achieving multiple victories over the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In the midst of the war, his old enemy Maul re-emerged into [[Galaxy|galactic]] affairs, bent on revenge against Kenobi for his debilitating defeat [[Standard decade|decades]] prior. Though they clashed in heated duels on multiple occasions, Maul failed to end Kenobi's life or cripple his spirit, despite murdering his former love, [[Satine Kryze]], [[Duchess]] of [[Mandalore]]. In [[19 BBY]], Kenobi killed the Separatist [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Martial Commander]], [[General]] [[Grievous]], during the [[Battle of Utapau]], effectively ending the Clone Wars. He later survived the initial onslaught of the Great Jedi Purge against the Jedi Order, which resulted from the [[Grand Plan|machinations]] of the Sith [[Lord]] Darth Sidious. After discovering that Skywalker had betrayed the Jedi and turned to the [[dark side of the Force]], becoming Sidious' [[Sith apprentice]] under the name of [[Darth]] Vader, Kenobi [[Duel on Mustafar|defeated]] his former Padawan on [[Mustafar]] and exiled himself to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine]] as the [[Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial Era|rose to power]]. Adopting a [[hermit]] lifestyle as "'''Ben Kenobi'''," he watched over Vader's and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s son, Luke. [[9 BBY|Ten years later]], Kenobi left exile to [[Search for Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], Luke's [[twin]] sister, and was pursued by the Empire's [[Inquisitorius]] and Vader himself. Later, Kenobi was hunted down once again by Maul, whom he finally slew to protect the young Luke. Kenobi began the boy's Jedi training in [[1 BBY]], and soon after [[Rescue of Princess Leia|encountered]] Vader aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first]] [[Death Star]], where he sacrificed himself to ensure that Luke and his allies escaped from the Sith Lord. In death, Kenobi became [[Immortality|one with the Force]] which allowed him to continue guiding Luke throughout the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY]], Kenobi reunited with his former student, Anakin Skywalker, who died [[Battle of Endor|destroying]] his [[Sith Master]] in order to save his son. Kenobi was remembered as a legendary Jedi Master during the [[New Republic Era|rise]] of the [[New Republic]]; [[Ben Solo]], the son of Luke's twin sister, Princess Leia Organa, was named after Kenobi. Solo's [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|turn to the dark side]] left Luke disillusioned with the Jedi Order's legacy, and he held Kenobi responsible for Anakin's transformation into Vader. However, Luke's faith would eventually be restored with the aid of Darth Sidious's granddaughter [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], to whom Kenobi would lend his voice and strength in a [[Battle of Exegol|final battle and victory]] against her resurrected ancestor on [[Exegol]] in [[35 ABY]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|As Jedi, we're taken from our families when we're very young. I still have glimpses, flashes really, my mother's shawl, my father's hands. I remember a baby. [...] I think I had a brother. Really don't remember him. I wished I did.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} Obi-Wan Kenobi was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Stewjon]] in [[57 BBY]]. Despite being very [[Youngling|young]] when he left his [[Kenobi family|family]], he still had glimpses of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's father|his father's]] [[hand]]s and his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's mother|mother's]] [[shawl]], and he remembered a [[Unidentified Kenobi baby|baby]] he believed to be his brother although he barely remembered him. ===Joining the Jedi Order=== {{Quote|…I never had problems with that as a youngling. Being independent, I mean. I broke rules right and left. They even called me rebellious. Probably the Masters were surprised anyone was willing to take me on as an apprentice.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Qui-Gon Jinn, about his early life|audio=ObiWanKenobi-MA2.flac|''[[Master & Apprentice]]''}} [[File:YoungKenobi-AORObiWan1.png|thumb|left|160px|Obi-Wan Kenobi as a Jedi youngling]] When Kenobi was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive]], he was taken from his [[homeworld]] to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training|trained]] as a [[Jedi]] within the first six [[Standard month|months]] of his life. In the [[Jedi crèche]] he was placed with other [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi younglings]] in the [[Kybuck Clan]] during his early [[Standard year|years]], including his friends [[Gehren Rand|Gehren]] and [[Prie]]. Kenobi received basic Initiate training alongside his peers in the [[Jedi Order]]'s Temple and began training in several simple [[Force power|Force techniques]] by the age of three in [[54 BBY]].{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Obi-Wan Kenobi - Padawan}} Kenobi studied in the ways of [[the Force]] and Jedi traditions{{StoryCite|story=There Is Always Another|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} under [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]], eventually coming to respect him and the [[Jedi High Council|Jedi Council]] greatly. He also received instruction in the art of [[lightsaber combat]] from [[Jedi Master]] [[Cin Drallig]]''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' in the basic [[lightsaber]] forms and techniques. At some point before he was selected as a [[Padawan]], Kenobi attended a class centered around [[meditation]]. Unlike how he acted as he got older,{{StoryCite|story=Master and Apprentice (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}} Kenobi, during his days as a youngling, gained a reputation for breaking rules and having a rebellious nature, resulting in very few Masters who were willing to train the boy as their Padawan. To curb Kenobi's behavior, Yoda searched for a teacher for Kenobi that had unorthodox methods, which would mold the student into rebelling by being dutiful. ===Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan=== ====Initial endeavors==== {{Quote|It worries me, this misunderstanding between you and your Padawan. This isn't the first time you've reported such difficulties.''"
"''It worries me as well. Obi-Wan is strong in the Force, and eager to do his duty. The failure must be mine. Fundamentally, I fear we are a mismatch.|Depa Billaba and Qui-Gon Jinn, about Obi-Wan Kenobi's training|audio=ObiWanKenobi-MA1.flac|}} [[File:ObiWanKenobiPadawan-TLC.png|thumb|right|250px|Kenobi was chosen by Qui-Gon Jinn to be his Padawan.]] Around [[44 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of ''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' in [[40 BBY]]. Obi-Wan Kenobi is established to have been assigned to [[Qui-Gon Jinn]]'s care four years prior to the novel, corresponding to around [[44 BBY]]. Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] chose Kenobi as his Padawan learner when he was thirteen years old. During his apprenticeship he became friends with [[Jape]], a fellow Padawan who he kept correspondence with, and also maintained contact with crèche-mate Prie and the [[Mon Calamari]] [[Bant Eerin]].''[[Choose Your Destiny: An Obi-Wan & Anakin Adventure]]'' In their first months together, Jinn attempted to adapt his teaching methods to suit Kenobi's strengths, but felt he failed to do so adequately. At some point during his training, Kenobi constructed his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber|first lightsaber]], modeled after Jinn's [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber|lightsaber]] hilt style and his own personality.{{EncyclopediaCite|Lightsabers and Jedi Equipment}} As the pair struggled to establish a workable affinity, the Master continued to train his Padawan in the basic [[cadence]]s of lightsaber combat, preventing him from picking a specialty. Jinn was proud of his apprentice's skills, and sparred with him in training sessions while at the Temple between missions. Kenobi, in turn, spent a significant amount of [[time]] in the training dojos to hone the techniques taught to him. In their lessons, Jinn taught Kenobi that there was a strength and nobility in restraint.[[Star Wars (2015) 7|''Star Wars'' (2015) 7]] As time passed, Kenobi's demeanor shifted to become more serious and respectful of the Council, in contrast to the maverick''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' Jinn's usual way of approaching situations based on his instincts in the present, even if that meant going against the Council's wishes. Both carried differing philosophies on focusing on the future versus the present, and interpreted the Force in varying ways. Despite their differences, Kenobi strived to be a good student, and supported his Master's hobbies regarding ancient Jedi prophecy research. To Kenobi's chagrin, the majority of his free time in the Temple was consumed by gathering information from the [[Jedi Archives]] and the [[holocron of prophecy]] under the watchful [[eye]] of the Jedi Master librarian [[Jocasta Nu]]. Over time, he learned the [[language]] [[Old Alderaanian]], which many of the [[holocron]]'s prophecies were written in. As an escape from the workload, Kenobi played rounds of the game [[dejarik]] in the lower levels of Coruscant in the evenings after finishing his Master's research requests. ====Early travels and visit to Kashyyyk==== {{Quote|The Trandoshans—they capture and hunt for sport. And they knew today was Life Day. And they knew the Wookiees would be vulnerable. Come Obi-Wan…we have to stop them!|Qui-Gon Jinn to Obi-Wan Kenobi|{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=3|story=Life Day (comic story)}}}} [[File:BrennonnKenobi.png|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Brennonn planning a rescue]] The pair's continuing training issues were discussed with Jedi Councilors [[Depa Billaba]] and [[Mace Windu]] in an attempt to find a remedy, without success. At some point during his time as a Padawan, Kenobi and Jinn visited a [[Chief's fortress|fortress]] on the planet [[Lah'mu]], the world [[Alderaan]]'s [[Royal Palace of Alderaan|royal palace]], and the planets [[Ryloth]] and [[Gatalenta]]. While training, he became acquainted with the Jedi trainee [[Siri Tachi]] and developed some feelings for her, but refrained from acting on them. Around [[41 BBY]], three years after becoming Jinn's Padawan, a sixteen-year-old Kenobi was eager to prove himself on a mission, but when he and Jinn were set to leave on one, his Master was nowhere to be found. Feeling angry by his master's abandonment, Kenobi decided to set off on the [[Mission to Lenahra|mission]] to the planet [[Lenahra]] alone. While he was there, he encountered a group of teenagers and [[datachip]]s hidden on the world by the Jedi [[Orla Jareni]] long before his visit.[[Padawan (novel)|''Padawan'']] He met a [[Besalisk]] named [[Dexter Jettster]], who became a close friend.[[Brotherhood (novel)|''Brotherhood'']] During his training, Kenobi traveled to the planet [[Kashyyyk]] with his Master during the [[Life Day]] holiday. Jinn used the trip to teach his student about the Wookiee's way of life and harmony, and how it related to their own connection to the Force. The festivities slightly overwhelmed Kenobi, though he took the lessons to heart, and met one of Jinn's acquaintances, the Wookiee [[Brennonn]]. However, their gathering was interrupted by [[Trandoshan]]s who captured several Wookiees, intending to use them in a [[Hunting|hunt]] for sport. Despite Kenobi's best efforts, Jinn was snared in a net as well and taken away. Though held captive, Jinn believed that his Padawan would rescue him from the Trandoshan hunters. Kenobi, though reluctant to put any more Wookiees in danger, formulated a plan with Brennonn to break the imprisoned individuals free. He proceeded to surrender himself to the Trandoshans, claiming that as a simple student, he stood no chance against them. While conversing with the hunters' leader, Kenobi subtly used the Force to open the cage holding Jinn. Once both Jedi brandished their lightsabers, several other Wookiees rushed to the scene and assisted in setting their friends free. After the situation was settled, the Wookiees opted to leave the group in peace, citing Life Day as reason to pursue a resolution without violence. When back at the festivities area, Kenobi remained confused as to why Jinn did not break himself free. However, the Master informed him that it was intended as a learning experience, and to gain insight from Wookiee perspectives on life.{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=4|story=Life Day Part 2}} ====Protecting Satine Kryze==== {{Quote|You and Satine have a history.''"
"''An extended mission when I was younger. Master Qui-Gon and I spent a year on Mandalore protecting the duchess from insurgents who had threatened her world. They sent Bounty hunters after us. We were always on the run, living hand-to-mouth, never sure what the next day would bring.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}}} Sometime between the years [[41 BBY]] and [[40 BBY]],In {{SW|url=news/kiersten-white-star-wars-padawan|text=Kiersten White on Telling a Tale of Young Obi-Wan in ''Star Wars: Padawan''}} author [[Kiersten White]] established that the plot of the novel [[Padawan (novel)|''Padawan'']] was explicitly written to convey that Obi-Wan Kenobi had not met [[Satine Kryze]], which "[[Voyage of Temptation]]" establishes was during the [[Great Clan Wars]]. ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of the novel to [[41 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' further states that the [[mission to Pijal]], which ''Timelines'' dates to [[40 BBY]], occurred after the civil war. Therefore, the war must occur between 41 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 40 BBY. Kenobi and Jinn spent a year on the planet [[Mandalore]] protecting [[Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze]] from insurgents who were [[Great Clan Wars|threatening]] her world. [[Bounty hunter]]s were sent after them, forcing them to live as fugitives, never knowing what the next day would bring them.{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}} The mission forced them to work and fight together as a team, resulting in them forging a close bond.{{StoryCite|story=Kenobi's Shadow|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} Kryze called Kenobi by the nickname "Ben." During that time, they had an incident with a swarm of [[venom-mite]]s on the terrestrial object [[Draboon]], where Kenobi carried Kryze to safety. However, he fell and dropped the Duchess, who then acquired a scar as a result. Kenobi fell in love with Satine during his stay on Mandalore, but despite his feelings toward her, he continued with his training and was reassigned to another mission after his objectives were complete. Kenobi regretted leaving her, but ultimately followed the [[Jedi Code]] he had sworn to live by. Meanwhile, Satine chose to stay and lead her people, having not asked Kenobi to stay, knowing it would have been a difficult choice. ====Incident on Teth==== {{Quote|Master? Are you all right?''"
"''Just get us a ship if you can!|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn on Teth|audio=ObiWanKenobi-MA3.flac|}} [[File:Teth-TVE.png|thumb|right|170px|Kenobi and his Master were sent to Teth on a mission.]] In 40 BBY, a seventeen-year old Kenobi and a forty-year-old Jinn were [[Mission to Teth|sent]] to the planet [[Teth]] to investigate the disappearance of agricultural shipments through the [[Triellus Trade Route|Triellus trade route]]. The pair ran into difficulties finding information, and their investigations quickly aroused the suspicions of the guilty parties. As their situation rapidly turned violent, Kenobi and Jinn stormed a building, using their lightsaber skills to force their way through the compound. In the chaos, Jinn felt that Kenobi was not responding to instructions well, and chose to make an escape. Jinn instructed Kenobi to find a [[Starship|ship]], though the Padawan failed to do so upon being stopped in a hangar. Kenobi was briefly held hostage by [[Wanbo]] the Hutt's [[majordomo]], [[Thurible]], but was soon released in exchange for Wanbo, who had been captured by Jinn. Eventually, the Jedi managed to depart the planet after making tenuous peace with Wanbo. Though both Jedi attempted to remain lighthearted about the outcome of the mission, Kenobi felt that he had failed his Master. Once on Coruscant, Jinn recounted the communication issues that had plagued him and Kenobi during the Teth mission to the Jedi Council. While citing their continued inability to form a strong bond, he surmised that they may not have been meant to be a pair. Jinn received an invitation to join the Council after the mission, which displeased Kenobi when he found out shortly after during a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Kirames Kaj]]. Jinn resolved to make a decision regarding the invitation after meditation, knowing accepting the invite would result in Kenobi's reassignment to another Master. ====Mission to Pijal==== {{Quote|The Jedi Council—the Council has named me the rightful representative of the Republic, for the purposes of the ceremony.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, on Pijal|audio=ObiWanKenobi-MA4.flac|}} [[File:PijalCover.jpg|thumb|left|197px|Obi-Wan, during the mission to Pijal]] [[Standard day|Days]] after his mission to Teth, a [[Politics|political]] dispute erupted on the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] planet [[Pijal]], which caught the attention of Kaj. Initial reports suggested a performance troupe called the [[Opposition]] was engaging in increasingly violent initiatives protesting the signing of the [[Governance Treaty]]— a move would end the absolutist [[Pijali monarchy|monarchy]]. Jinn and Kenobi were informed that [[Lord]] [[Regent]] [[Rael Averross]] had requested their aid on the planet and its [[Pijal's moon|moon]] to curb the attacks, discover more about their origins, and ensure the opening of the [[Pijal Hyperspace Corridor]] [[hyperspace route]]. Both Jedi were additionally instructed to to protect the [[Pijali]] [[Crown]] [[Princess]] [[Fanry]] until she could sign the treaty at her [[Coronation of Queen Fanry|coronation]], and ratify the initiative on behalf of the Republic. Kenobi and Jinn were dispatched to the planet, and the Master took the opportunity to inform his Padawan about Averross's training under Dooku. Upon their arrival to the [[Pijal system]], they spotted several [[soulcraft]] vessels suffering from [[plasma]] attacks, and moved to save the ships. Helped by an antiplasma charge, Kenobi and Jinn rescued several soulcraft and the slaves inside. Jinn and Kenobi were regally greeted by Fanry upon their arrival to the [[Pijali palace]]. Upon being briefed on the situation, the pair used a small [[shuttle]] to meet with the [[gemstone]] thieves [[Rahara Wick]] and [[Pax Maripher]] on the world's [[moon]]. After some negotiation, the thieves agreed to assist the Jedi in their search for the Opposition and its leader, [[Halin Azucca]]. Kenobi and Jinn made several trips to the moon, and their scans for the Opposition came up unsuccessful. While on the palace grounds, Kenobi participated in the ritual [[Grand Hunt]] while riding a [[Pijal varactyl]]. During the ceremonial hunt, the [[LM-432 crab droid|crab droid]] prey of the event attacked Fanry, prompting Kenobi to destroy the threat. Upon investigation, he and his Master concluded that the sabotage must have been conducted by someone within the palace, and not the Opposition. Eventually, Kenobi and Jinn met with Azucca on Pijal's moon, and she claimed that her group of performance artists had been framed for the attacks blamed on them. With this knowledge, Jinn refused to ratify the Governance Treaty at Fanry's upcoming coronation after receiving a violent [[Force vision]] about the events. Azucca later provided information to the Jedi proving that the attacks on Czerka facilities were found to have originated from [[blackguard]]s, a division of the Pijali [[Royal guard (Pijal)|royal guards]] secretly under the orders of Captain [[Deren]] and Fanry. Kenobi, knowing that Jinn would refuse to sign the treaty, was appointed to ratify the initiative on the Republic's behalf in his place by the Jedi Council. However, at Fanry's coronation, the princess violently seized power as an absolute monarch to prevent the signing of the treaty, decrying democracy. Kenobi attempted to protect the [[Unidentified Skykeeper|Skykeeper]] leader from her when Fanry ordered the [[death]] of those she percieved had betrayed her. Kenobi listened to Fanry's speech about the greed of her elders, and used his [[kohlen crystal]] sabotaged lightsaber to attack Deren. Following the injury of her captain, the newly crowned queen escaped the [[Celestial Chalice]] where the event had been held with her confidante [[Cady]], leaving the Skykeeper, the [[Unidentified court jeweler|jeweler]], and Kenobi behind. While Jinn tried to negotiate with Fanry over [[hologram]], Kenobi helped the slaves aboard the Czerka cruiser, ''[[Leverage]],'' with Maripher's help. Eventually, Cady ended her rule by holding her at [[blaster]]-point until she surrendered. However, because Fanry had threatened to harm Kenobi while he was acting as a Republic representative, the crowning was deemed illegitimate. Kenobi and Jinn helped the planet establish a democratic [[Assembly (Pijal)|Assembly]] after Fanry's abdication, and reported back to Coruscant afterwards. Kenobi felt that the mission had been one of the first that he and his Master were able to work well together. However, he also realized that his pairing with Jinn had strengthened his resolve to be a "Perfect Jedi" and follow the Jedi Code in all aspects, if only to be rebellious towards an unorthodox teacher. ====Saving Th'er==== {{Quote|Where are we heading, Master?|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Qui-Gon Jinn when escaping from the Metal Clan|[[Age of Republic - Qui-Gon Jinn 1|''Age of Republic - Qui-Gon Jinn'' 1]]}} [[File:ObiWanPiloting-AORQuiGonJinn1.png|thumb|right|190px|Obi-Wan during the rescue of priestess Th'er]] The Jedi Order later sent Kenobi and Jinn to the planet [[Bri'n]] to resolve a [[Conflict on Bri'n|conflict]] on the world. On Bri'n, the [[Metal Clan leader|leader]] of the [[Metal Clan]] attempted to capture [[priestess]] [[Th'er]] so that either her word or her [[blood]] could be used to destroy her [[tree]]s. Surrounded by forces of the Metal Clan, Jinn chose to escape with Th'er in an [[Eta-class shuttle|''Eta''-class shuttle]] and return to Coruscant. Once on planet, Kenobi watched, without interjection, as Th'er attempted to convince Qui-Gon to intervene in her conflict. However, she eventually chose to seek allies on Coruscant instead. ====Operating near Botor==== {{Quote|Holy…blaster bolts. How did [Yoda] take out a whole room full of pirates?|Obi-Wan Kenobi|[[Star Wars (2015) 26|''Star Wars'' (2015) 26]]}} [[File:ObiWanAndQuiGon-2015StarWars26.jpg|thumb|left|233px|Obi-Wan and Qui-Gon landed on Botor, to discover Yoda rescued a young Force-sensitive child from a pirate gang who attempted to sell him.]] At some point around 40 BBY, Jinn and Kenobi were operating in the vicinity of a [[Botor|planet]] that served as a base of the [[Flesh Mongers]] [[pirate]] group, flying a pair of [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]]. The two received a message from the surface of the planet from Jedi Master Yoda, who was asking for assistance. Landing on the planet, Jinn and Kenobi discovered that Yoda had taken out the entire pirate gang in order to rescue a young Force-sensitive child, known as [[Lo]], as the pirate had planned to sell him due to his abilities in the Force. After leaving the child in Kenobi and Jinn's care, Yoda departed for his next objective. ===Invasion of Naboo=== ====Ambassadors to the Supreme Chancellor==== {{Quote|I have a bad feeling about this.''"
"''I don't sense anything.''"
"''It's not about the mission, Master. It's something elsewhere… elusive.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=BadFeelingAboutThis-TPM.flac|}} [[File:PadawanKenobi-TPM.png|thumb|right|215px|Kenobi during the invasion of Naboo]] In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], by the time Jinn considered Kenobi to be ready for his [[Jedi Trials|trials]], they were sent by Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum]] to negotiate with the [[Trade Federation]], who had set up a [[Invasion of Naboo|blockade]] around the planet of [[Naboo]]. Both Jedi extensively studied political documents and trade relations between the parties prior to the endeavor, sensing its necessity.''[[Queen's Peril]]'' The two Jedi were tasked with negotiating a settlement with Trade Federation representatives. The pair traveled to the system on the [[Consular-class light cruiser|''Consular''-class space cruiser]] ''[[Radiant VII]]'' and landed on the modified [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] ''[[Saak'ak]]'', the [[flagship]] of the [[blockade]]. There, Kenobi and Jinn were brought to a conference room, where [[protocol droid]] [[TC-14]] informed them that a Trade Federation representative would be with them shortly, and invited the pair to make themselves comfortable. However, upon learning that the pair were Jedi from TC-14, [[Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]] of the Trade Federation instead sent the protocol droid back into the room to distract them, with the droid offering Kenobi and Jinn drinks. Gunray then ordered his security to get rid of the Jedi and their assets, with an overhead [[turret]] destroying the ''Radiant VII'' and its crew. The two Jedi sensed the loss of their vessel and rose from their seats, drawing their lightsabers before noticing [[poison]]ous [[dioxis]] [[gas]] being pumped into the room around them and holding their breaths. [[OOM-series security droid]]s were then sent to confirm that the Jedi were dead, however Kenobi and Jinn escaped into the hallway and destroyed the [[battle droid]]s before making their way to the ''Saak'ak''{{'s}} bridge. Kenobi held off the battle droids while Jinn attempted to cut through the doors to the bridge. However, [[droideka]]s summoned by Gunray arrived, and the two Jedi were forced to flee into a nearby ventilation shaft, using [[Force Dash|Force speed]] to escape. The two [[Escape from the Saak'ak|escaped]] to Naboo's surface by stowing away on separate [[C-9979 landing craft]]s in the Saak'ak's [[hangar]] bay, discovering a droid [[army]] preparing to invade Naboo in the process. ====Rescuing Queen Amidala==== After arriving on Naboo, Kenobi was attacked by two Federation [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform]]s while en route to Jinn's location. He was rescued by his Master, who was accompanied by [[Jar Jar Binks]], a member of Naboo's native [[Gungan]] [[species]]. After some debate, Binks agreed to lead the two Jedi to [[Otoh Gunga]], a hidden [[Water|underwater]] Gungan [[city]] where the group was brought before the Gungan leader [[Boss]] [[Rugor Nass|Nass]]. Though unable to convince the Gungans to help the humans of Naboo, Jinn [[Mind trick|influenced]] Nass to obtain [[Tribubble bongo|transport]], to allow them to reach Naboo's [[capital]] [[Theed]]. [[Pilot]]ing the transport through the planet's [[Naboo Abyss|core]], the trio was attacked by an [[Opee sea killer]] at one point, which led to the ship being damaged and electronic systems shutting down. Kenobi quickly fixed the issue with some rewiring, and after a brief encounter with a [[Sando aqua monster]], Kenobi, Jinn, and Binks reached Theed. Upon their arrival, the group discovered that the Trade Federation had already taken control of Theed, finding empty streets. The two Jedi came across a group of battle droids taking [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Amidala]] and several others to an internment camp, and quickly engaged the droids, freeing the queen and her companions. Following this, the Jedi moved to a nearby hangar, intending to use a Naboo starship to take the queen to Coruscant. Kenobi moved to liberate several pilots who were held [[prisoner]] by battle droids, while his master took the rest of their group to a ship. After a brief skirmish, the group fled Naboo in the queen's [[Naboo Royal Starship|starship]] in an attempt to reach Coruscant with news of the Trade Federation invasion. During the escape, the ship's [[hyperdrive]] was damaged by droid [[starfighter]]s, preventing them from jumping straight to Coruscant and forcing them to instead land on [[Tatooine]] for repairs. ====Return of the Sith==== [[File:NiceToMeetYouFutureMassMurderer-TPM.png|thumb|left|250px|Kenobi meets Anakin Skywalker.]] After landing on the [[desert]] world, Kenobi remained on the ship, while Jinn, Binks, the droid [[R2-D2]], and Amidala, who was disguised as a [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaiden]], went to search for a new hyperdrive unit. While searching, Jinn discovered [[Anakin Skywalker]], a young enslaved human from whom he retrieved a blood sample for analysis, believing the child to be strong in the Force. Jinn sent the data to Kenobi on the ship, with instructions for Kenobi to analyze it. Kenobi's analysis revealed that the boy's [[midi-chlorian]] count was higher than that of any Jedi. When Jinn arrived, accompanied by Skywalker, [[Darth]] [[Maul]], a Sith apprentice, attacked Jinn prompting Kenobi to order the ship to take off, with Jinn leaping into the ship as it ascended. The group then proceeded to Coruscant. Upon their arrival on the planet, Jinn and Kenobi went directly to the Jedi Council to report on the mysterious attacker, whom Jinn believed to be a [[Sith Lord]]. After being briefed on what to do about their mysterious attacker, Jinn discussed about Skywalker with the Council, believing him to be the [[Chosen One]]. Nevertheless, the Council was determined that the boy not be trained. However, Jinn persevered, telling them that he would take the boy as his Padawan, despite the Jedi Code's restrictions, but Kenobi insisted he was ready to take the trials, and his master agreed. Instead of discussing the matter further, Mace Windu sent the pair back to Naboo to protect the Queen and also as an attempt to lure out the mysterious assailant. [[File:Kenobi_Maul_clash.png|thumb|right|262px|Obi-Wan Kenobi fighting Darth Maul after his Master was impaled.]] After returning to Naboo, Binks located the Gungans and Amidala, revealing herself to be the true Queen, [[Boss Meetup|begged]] Boss Nass to provide assistance in fighting the droid armies of the Trade Federation. Boss Nass agreed to [[Battle of Naboo|fight]] the droids as a diversion, while the Queen's forces slipped into Theed and captured Gunray. However, they soon encountered Maul once again and engaged in a duel with him, biding time for Amidala and her forces to reach the throne room. During the duel with Maul, Kenobi was separated from his master and forced to watch as Maul impaled Jinn with [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber|his]] [[double-bladed lightsaber]] so, when the opportunity arose, Kenobi, filled with rage, retaliated against the Sith. However, the [[Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak]] gained the upper hand and knocked Kenobi into a nearby shaft, where he was barely able to grab onto a knob jutting out from the side before falling to his death. Maul used this opportunity to kick his lightsaber into the shaft. Despite his predicament, Kenobi was able to use his Jinn's lightsaber to [[Dismemberment|cut]] the Sith in half, whose body fell down the shaft, presumably dead. Kenobi then ran to his master's side and promised a dying Jinn that he would train Skywalker. ===Master of the Chosen One=== ====The first years==== {{Quote|Confer on you the level of Jedi Knight, the Council does. But agree with your taking this boy as your Padawan learner, I do not.''"
"''Qui-Gon believed in him.''"
"''The Chosen One, the boy may be. Nevertheless, grave danger, I fear, in his training.|Yoda and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=ObiWanKnighted-TPM.flac|}} [[File:You_will_be_a_Jedi.png|thumb|left|260px|Kenobi and Skywalker at Jinn's funeral.]] Following the end of the Battle of Naboo, Kenobi was promoted to the rank of [[Jedi Knight]] by the Council, with Yoda reluctantly accepting his decision to train Skywalker. Kenobi was later present during Jinn's [[Jedi funeral|funeral]], where he informed the boy that he would become a Jedi. Along with Amidala and her court, Kenobi and Skywalker remained at the funeral long after the Jedi Council had left, waiting until every last ember had gone out. Though he deeply grieved the loss of his teacher, Kenobi also felt that Jinn had abruptly cast him aside in favor of prophecies and unbending belief in Skywalker as the Chosen One. Nonetheless, as he watched his mentor's body in its final moments, he promised that he would chose to believe the prophecies. Later on, Kenobi, alongside his new Padawan and several members of the Jedi Council, took part in a [["Liberation Day" Parade|victory celebration]] in Theed. During his first year as Skywalker's Master, he sometimes woke up at night to see his Padawan was sleeping on the floor next to his bed; he realized Skywalker, having lost both his mother and Jinn, was clinging onto him, desperate to ensure his new master did not vanish one night. During one of their many adventures, Kenobi fell into a nest of [[gundark]]s, prompting Skywalker to rescue him.{{Film|II}} At the Jedi Temple, Kenobi trained Skywalker in meditation and levitating rocks. Though Skywalker wished to know more about his mentor's early life, he did not remember much of it by that point. Kenobi had several misgivings toward taking on Skywalker as his Padawan, but stuck to his firm commitment of honoring his late master's dying wish. But Kenobi was still mourning Jinn, and he began to have the perspective that Skywalker got a very raw deal being forced to be with a master who was hardly fit to be a teacher and had just barely got beyond the Jedi trials himself.''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]'' ====Mission to Dallenor==== {{Quote|Thank you for coming master Jedi. My name is Clatriffe. I'm in charge of the Dallenor excavation.|Clatriffe|}} Kenobi was given a [[Mission to Dallenor|mission]] to go to the planet [[Dallenor]], where an archaeology team had discovered a [[Jedi holocron]]. Kenobi decided to take Skywalker with him as part of his training. Kenobi went to the Temple Archives to find information on Dallenor and about any Jedi that went there, to no avail. He told Master Yoda that he would bring his apprentice with him, to which Yoda surprisingly agreed. Kenobi and Skywalker took a [[T-6 shuttle]] to Dallenor. [[File:MissionToDallenor-AORObiWan1.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kenobi prepares to defend against the Krypder Riders.]] Upon their arrival, Kenobi met mistress [[Clatriffe]], who told of her troubles with the local pirates. Kenobi was told of Clatriffe's discovery of centuries-old droids and how she had to hire several of the locals for protection. Kenobi examined the Holocron, but did not open it due to the arrival of the [[Krypder Riders]] and their leader, [[Hudso Shaku]]. Kenobi attempted to convince them to leave, but Shaku and the riders demanded the artifacts and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber|Kenobi's lightsaber]]. Kenobi fought the riders and subdued them. Kenobi then saw that Shaku had taken Skywalker hostage and demanded his lightsaber. Before Obi-Wan could give a reply, Anakin was able to knock Shaku out with rocks. ====Other adventures with Skywalker and a crisis of faith==== {{Quote|To leave the Order, does Anakin wish?''"
"''Possibly, Master Yoda. He believes that his path lies elsewhere. He wishes to leave his training behind, at least for now. He says he will return, but… I don't know where I ''failed''. I have done my best to ''teach'' him. He ''belongs'' here. He's not ''ready''. He's too ''young''.''"
"''As are you, Obi-Wan. As are you. Your fault it is not. A child Anakin remains. His path before coming to us…difficult. His questions…natural.|Yoda and Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi debate about the future of Anakin Skywalker|[[Obi-Wan and Anakin 1|''Obi-Wan and Anakin'' 1]]}} [[File:ObiWan_hood.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi]] A couple of years later, Obi-Wan and Anakin traveled to the planet [[Ilum]] so that Skywalker could build [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber|his first lightsaber]];''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' after its construction, Kenobi said to him, "Anakin, this weapon is your life."{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}{{TCW|The Big Bang}} When Skywalker was twelve years old, Kenobi was assigned a mission to study a [[Unidentified dead star system|star system]] that revolved, seemingly impossibly, around a [[Black dwarf|dead dwarf star]]. Upon realizing Skywalker had secretly snuck aboard his starship, Kenobi elected to turn the mission into a teaching experience, telling Skywalker of the dead [[star]] as a metaphor for how Jedi needed to learn to let go of their attachments. Despite his initial misgivings about Skywalker, having once believed him to be dangerous and would do more harm than good, Kenobi soon grew to view the boy as a his equal, finding a partner in their missions, and came to see him as his brother. At some point, Kenobi and Skywalker, during a mission in which they were they were joined by Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti]], were involved in complicated business on the terrestrial astronomical object of [[Naran-Shiv]]. In [[29 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Obi-Wan and Anakin 2|''Obi-Wan and Anakin'' 2]] to [[29 BBY]]. Skywalker sought to impress his peers at the Jedi Temple. During a training session, he defeated a [[Jedi training droid|training droid]], which he had programmed to mimic the appearance of the Sith of Naboo. All the while, Mace Windu, Kenobi and Supreme Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] watched—the latter of whom was impressed. Sometime later, Skywalker struggled to learn the [[Taming beasts|skill of taming creatures]] when Kenobi told him that the Chancellor wanted to see him.
