Despite this, she willingly led a quest to restore the Jedi Order with the intent of building a better future rather than restoring the past<ref name="Art JFO" /> and wished to end the tyranny of the Galactic Empire. She was also an opponent to [[High Human]] culture, disapproving of the notions that droids and non-humanoids were inferior to humans.<ref name="Fallen Order" />

Despite not presenting herself as a Jedi following the Purge, she still carried much of the wisdom that was passed down to her. She believed that people should remember the mistakes of the past and change things going forward to make sure they never happened again, and the adaptation was important - whether that was a course of action or a idea, people had to be ready to change. She would encourage Kestis to put his trust in the Force and allow it to sharpen his instincts.<ref name="Fallen Order" />

==Skills and abilities==
===Lightsaber abilities===
Cere was a extraordinarily skilled lightsaber duelist whose skills improved over the course of her life, demonstrating the ability to redirect blaster with her lightsaber and during her later years, proved to be considerable enough to combat [[Purge Trooper]]s with ease.<ref name="Fallen Order" /> Believing herself to be among the most able of surviving Jedi during the [[Imperial Era]], her abilities were advanced enough to outmatch and intimidate [[Inquisitor]]s such as the Fifth Brother<ref name="Battle Scars" /> and engage in battle with the [[Sith Lord]], Darth Vader, in a grueling duel and nearly prevailed.<ref name="Jedi Survivor" /> Cere exhibited an aggressive combat style characterized by brute strength and was similar to the style employed by [[Fifth Brother]] performed but in a effective manner.<ref name="Battle Scars" /> Alternatively, she was also capable of an unorthodox lightsaber-blaster hybrid style, combining her abilities with a lightsaber and a blaster with her agility to gain an advantage.<ref name="Fallen Order" />

===Force power===
{{Quote|Yes. Strong with the dark side. I feel it inside of her.|Darth Vader about Junda's true power|<ref name="Fallen Order" />}}
Junda possessed tremendous power and potential within the Force, with her connection to the dark side of the Force apt enough for Darth Vader to consider her a prime candidate for an [[Inquisitor]].<ref name="Fallen Order" /> Her abilities matched or surpassed Fifth Brother, whom specialized in using force abilities. Towards the end of her life as a Jedi Master, her force abilities also made her a match for Darth Vader enough to contend with him.<ref name="Jedi Survivor" />

She was skilled in telekinetic abilities such as [[Force push]], [[Telekinesis|Force pull]], and could use [[Force Dash]] in offensive situations.<ref name="Jedi Survivor" /> These telekinetic abilities were advanced enough to stop a [[Double-bladed spinning lightsaber]] to a halt and break down each part of the lightsaber to disassemble it in battle as well as use [[Force Stasis]] powerful enough to halt [[Inquisitor]]s.<ref name="Battle Scars" /> Junda could also create a [[Force barrier]] similar in appearance and potency to a [[ray shield]], a barrier that was capable of stopping Darth Vader's lightsaber briefly. For a time, this would leave her unconsious<ref name="Fallen Order" /> though she later improved, able to perform so without being incapacitated from the effort.<ref name="Jedi Survivor" /> With the dark side of the Force, she proved capable of inflicting mass destruction and killing a multitude of people when giving in to despair, fear and rage by involuntarily releasing a shockwave that broke her free from her interrogation chair, killing all but her fallen Padawan. Though it was not enough to stop him, Junda was notably capable of slowing the incredibly powerful Vader down with the power of the dark side for a few seconds, something the Sith Lord was impressed by.<ref name="Fallen Order" />

===Other skills===
An expert on technology and knowledgable on those used by the Empire,<ref name="Battle Scars" /> Junda was proficient in slicing, a skill she taught her Padawan, Trilla Sunduri,<ref name="Fallen Order" /> and eventually rebuilt her own [[The Archive|archive]].<ref name="Jedi Survivor" /> She was also a proficient marksman and [[Seven-string hallikset|hallikset]] player.<ref name="Fallen Order" /> 

==Equipment==
[[File:Cere_Junda_lightsaber_hilt.jpg|250px|thumb|right|Cere Junda's lightsaber on her funeral pyre]]
During the time of the Galactic Republic, Junda possessed Jedi robes and a [[Cere Junda's lightsaber|lightsaber]] with a [[Color|green]] blade, both of which she abandoned the use of during the first years of the Empire<ref name="Dark Temple 1" /> in favor of a [[DL-18 blaster pistol]]. During this time, she also acquired from Kestis her former apprentice Trilla's Inquisitor lightsaber, which she made use of in conjunction with her pistol during her incursion on Nur with Kestis. During the time separated from Cal, Junda created a [[Cere Junda's second lightsaber|new lightsaber]] with a blue blade.<ref name="Jedi Survivor" /> She possessed a [[seven-string hallikset]] that Kestis once found and used [[psychometry]] to play.<ref name="Fallen Order" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cere Junda is a character created for the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'', released on [[November 15]], [[2019]]. She is portrayed by [[Debra Wilson]].<ref name="Jedi: Fallen Order panel">{{SWYouTube|5H6LQkxwVxc|The Galaxy-Wide Premiere of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order Live Panel at SWCC 2019}}</ref> In the initial design phase for the character, Junda had a cane and physical scars. The production team originally planned on giving her a debilitating physical wound that came as a result of the Imperial torture but ultimately decided on following the story arc of a crisis of faith in herself and the Force.<ref name="Art of Fallen Order">''[[The Art of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>

During the battle, Zettifar briefly reunited with Greatstorm and was left devastated when his severely weakened former master was killed by the [[Great Leveler]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== [[File:BellZettifarGreatDisaster.png|thumb|left|180px|Bell Zettifar]] Bell Zettifar was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Reproduction|born]] in [[250 BBY]] on [[Chandrila]]. At some point, a young [[charhound]] appeared at the outpost's door with an infected wound. Stokes treated the wound, Engle fed her and Zettifar named her [[Ember]]. Zettifar then introduced his charhound to the rest of the group, with Ember breathing out fire in excitement. Master Zanna then invited the two guests for a tour of the temple, though Zettifar denied the invitation, wanting to take Ember for a walk after their long flight instead. Brightstar took the two to the temple's [[Tenoo's Training Field|training field]], where Ember was able to run around freely. ===Nihil Conflict=== ====The Great Disaster==== [[File:Lodenbellonhetzal.png|thumb|left|250px|Zettifar and Loden Greatstorm on Hetzal Prime during the Great Hyperspace Disaster]] In [[232 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' to [[232 BBY]]. the ''[[Legacy Run]]'' was destroyed in what became known as the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]] and sent pieces of the [[starship]] hurtling across [[the galaxy]]. Zettifar and Greatstorm were part of the Republic response team sent to the [[Hetzal system]] to protect the evacuating civilians. On the surface of [[Hetzal Prime]], the two Jedi confronted a group of security guards that were preventing a large group of citizens from attaining passage offworld as was ordered by [[Minister]] [[Zeffren Ecka]]. Zettifar and his master ended up having to fight off a force of attacking pirates as well as deal with the guards. ====Raid on Elphrona==== In the aftermath of the Great Disaster, Zettifar and his master traveled back to the [[Elphrona Outpost|Jedi outpost]] on the planet [[Elphrona]]. Zettifar continued to be trained by Greatstorm, who worked to help him master [[controlled descent]] from a great height by aid of [[the Force]]. Zettifar was unsuccessful with learning the maneuver and had to be saved by Stokes, who Greatstorm had positioned on the ground in case his Padawan was in danger. Zettifar was embarrassed that he had to be saved, but he then went to eat with Stokes when Engle announced that he was making [[Nine-Egg Stew]]. However, their meal was interrupted when the Jedi received a distress signal from the [[Blythe family]]. The four Jedi showed up at the [[Blythe homestead]] and found that they had been kidnapped. They chased down the [[Nihil]] raiders that had captured them, splitting up at one point so Stokes could get a ship and Engle could take care of the enemy rearguard. [[File:BellZettifar-TRS.png|thumb|right|200px|Bell Zettifar]] Zettifar and Greatstorm recovered the mother, [[Erika Blythe|Erika]], and defended her as the enemy ship strafed the area. When they pursued the ship into space, Zettifar would leave his master's side to save the daughter, [[Bailen Blythe|Bailen]], whom the Nihil had ejected into space in an attempt to lose their pursuers. Realising that using the Force was not about saving himself, but saving others, Zettifar finally mastered the ability to control his descent and saved Bailen. In recognition of this feat of heroism, Greatstorm declared over comm that he intended to put Zettifar forward to be Knighted by the [[Jedi High Council]] and told Zettifar that he would see him after saving Bailen's father. Unfortunately, Greatstorm did not return and he was presumed killed in a blast that destroyed his [[Vector]], although Zettifar alone felt that he had survived. ====Dedication of Starlight Beacon==== In the aftermath of losing Greatstorm, Zettifar refused to take his vows as a Jedi Knight on [[Coruscant]] being unable to countenance such a thing without his master there to preside over the ceremony. Stokes therefore took Zettifar as her Padawan and vowed to continue his training. Zettifar attended the [[dedication of the Starlight Beacon]] with his new master and Engle. Ember also went with Zettifar and no one had the heart to tell him otherwise in the aftermath of Greatstorm's supposed death. At the dedication, Zettifar and Ember were greeted by Kai Brightstar, who asked to stand with Zettifar during the ceremony.''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'' — "[[The Prince and the Pirate]]" ====Vioddle repairs==== In his free time, Bell Zettifar took up learning to play the [[electric vioddle|vioddle]] as a hobby. At some point, he damaged his instrument and traveled to [[Bogachi]] with Kai Brightstar to seek repairs from the [[Nautolan]] music shop owner [[Jasa Plynn]]. As Plynn began repairs, their pet [[Flim (creature)|Flim]] entered a hypnotic trance and marched out of town. Zettifar and Brightstar followed, only to find every creature in town, including Ember, marching away. Joined by Plynn and Brightstar's [[astromech droid]] [[Beepers]], Zettifar and Brightstar discovered a [[kloo horn]] [[musician|player]] named [[Newf Grayson]] had used a [[sound wave modulator]] to hypnotize creatures into becoming a captive audience of fans. Zettifar engaged Grayson in a musical duel as Brightstar attempted to flank the rogue musician and disable the sound wave modulator and save Ember and Flim. Brightstar used the Force to overload the specialized speaker, breaking the trance and incapacitating Grayson. At Zettifar's urging, Grayson decided to build his audience organically and apologized for his bad behavior. Grayson, impressed at Zettifar's musical ability, hoped the two could jam together again in the future.{{YJA|Bell and the Band}} ====Attack on Cyclor==== In [[231 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' to [[231 BBY]]. Zettifar and Stokes were no longer stationed at the [[Elphrona Outpost]]. In the lead up to the [[Republic Fair]] on [[Valo]], the pair were tasked with inspecting the new [[Elite-class vessel|''Elite''-class vessel]], the ''[[Innovator]]'', at the [[Cyclor Shipyards]] and escorting it to Valo where it was set to be a main exhibition.''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' However, a Nihil Cloud launched an attack on the Shipyards in an attempt to destroy and scavenge the ship. Stokes and Zettifar defended the shipyards, however Zettifar was gravely injured when the Nihil command ship harpooned his Vector and impaled him. He was only saved from the vacuum of space because of a powerful display of telekinesis by Stokes. Before losing consciousness, Zettifar was able to destroy the Nihil command ship. The timely arrival of Engle and a wing of Jedi Vectors turned the tide of the battle and Zettifar ultimately survived after being rushed to a bacta tank. After recovering, Stokes and Zettifar escorted the ''Innovator'' to Valo in time for the opening of the Republic Fair. ====Valo Republic Fair==== [[File:Bellzettifarinnovator.png|thumb|left|200px|Bell Zettifar holds up the collapsing ''Innovator'' with the Force]] At the fair, Zettifar made the acquaintance of [[Chancellor]] [[Lina Soh]]'s son [[Kitrep Soh]] along with the local mayor's son [[Jom Lariin]]. The next day he was tasked by Council member [[Stellan Gios]] with finding the two boys when they absconded from a tour of the exhibits. While Zettifar was searching for the pair on the ''Innovator'', the fair was attacked by the Nihil. In the chaos, the ''Innovator'' began to collapse and sink into the water. Zettifar saved a number of people from it and managed to protect both Kitrep and Jom. ====Battle of Grizal==== Having survived the devastation on Varo, Stokes and Zettifar stowed aboard a ship headed for the Nihil secret base and after they arrived planted a tracker which led a battle wing on Jedi led by Gios to the planet. The Jedi managed to destroy the base, though many Nihil escaped into hyperspace. [[File:Bellzettifarleveler.png|thumb|200px|The Great Leveler approaches Bell Zettifar during the Battle of Grizal]] During the battle, Zettifar was briefly reunited with Greatstorm and the two fought together against the Nihil. However, [[Eye of the Nihil]] [[Marchion Ro]] unleashed the [[Great Leveler]], a [[Shrikarai|Nameless]] beast which fed on the Force. Zettifar and Master [[Elzar Mann]] were left shellshocked by the Leveler while the severely weakened Greatstorm was killed - reduced to a petrified husk. ====Traveling to Eiram==== Zettifar traveled on Starlight Beacon as it was being towed through [[hyperspace]] by the ''[[Halcyon]]'' and other Republic ships to [[Eiram]]. After it arrived in orbit, he went to the surface of the planet to assist with the aid efforts.''[[The High Republic: The Battle for Starlight]]'' ====Attacking the Nihil==== Zettifar was present with other Jedi on a [[Longbeam-class corvette|Longbeam cruiser]] as it made its way through the [[Nefitifi]] system nebula, searching for the Nihil. He informed his master, Indeera Stokes, that there were no transmissions in the [[Nefitifi system]]. The Jedi reached out with the Force and were able to locate a Nihil ship. Bell and the other Jedi boarded it, using rebreathers to neutralize the Nihil's gas attacks. Zettifar was pleased that he was taking the fight to the Nihil, but cautioned himself to not feel vengeance against his enemies. The Jedi proceeded to take over the ship and capture prisoners.''[[The High Republic: The Fallen Star]]'' ====Fall of Starlight==== They traveled to [[Starlight Beacon]] to drop off the prisoners for interrogation. Bell was tasked with checking the supplies in the [[Medical and science research tower|medical tower]]. After that, his master advised him to take some time to recuperate. Zettifar and his friend [[Burryaga Agaburry]] agreed to meditate together, but Zettifar wanted to see his pet charhound, Ember, first. The group watched as [[Chancey Yarrow]] and [[Nan Hague|Nan]] were taken to a [[Starlight Beacon detention center|detention cell]]. Soon after, refugees from the Nihil attacks started to arrive at Starlight Beacon. Zettifar assisted with the wounded but started to dwell too much on the pain and injuries. Agaburry took him aside and told Zettifar that he needed to take a break before he became overwhelmed. They left the medical tower and went to the observation deck where Zettifar talked to the [[Wookiee]] about his distress at not realizing that his former master had been captured and tortured by the Nihil. The Padawan regretted not trying to do something to rescue Greatstorm. The two padawans went to spar. During the session, Zettifar felt as something was off on Starlight Beacon, but couldn't place it. Agaburry confirmed the feeling. As they pondered what to do, the docking bay doors opened and Zettifar realized that more refugees were arriving. As the padawans went to help out, Zettifar came across [[Ghirra Starros]] who was leaving the station. He felt that she was up to something, but was unable to sense anything with the Force. The Jedi onboard Starlight Beacon assembled to discuss the attack on [[Chespea Temple]]. While most wanted to concentrate on the refugees of the various Nihil attacks, Zettifar suggested the more important task was to figure out what was effecting the Force users on the station. Several days after the Nihil [[saboteur]]s arrived on Starlight Beacon, they met Zettifar as he was giving out rations. He finished his duties and talked to Stokes about investigating the disruption of the Force they were feeling. She told him that she was going to do it, and refused his help. He was sent to finish his tasks, such as inventorying the refugee's cargo manifests. She tried to assuage his fears of losing another master by telling him she would be with other Jedi and she would be careful. He returned to the medical tower and continued to help with patients. After Stokes was attacked in the [[Cargo bay (Starlight Beacon)|cargo bay]] by a [[Shrikarai|Nameless]] and brought to the medical tower, Zettifar was horrified that he hadn't felt his master being attacked through the Force. He stayed with his master through the evening, missing the nightly distribution of rations. Agaburry stopped by with the food, and inquired about Stokes. Zettifar said he couldn't connect to his master through the Force. Agaburry suggested they try to work together but Zettifar discovered that they still couldn't access the Force and it felt like it was distorted and far away. [[File:Starlightbeaconexplodes.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Starlight Beacon explodes]] Zettifar was still in the medical tower when the bombs planted by the Nihil exploded, heavily damaging the station. He tried to calm the patients as the lights went out and emergency power engaged. He tried to contact the Hub, but couldn't get through. He comforted Ember and strategized with Agaburry about their next steps. A [[droid]] pointed out that an [[Eiram medical cruiser]] had approached the station. Zettifar pondered how to make contact with it when Agaburry suggested using an [[Unidentified LT-16 droid|LT-16 droid]]. The droid responded that its transmission range was limited but Zettifar figured out that they could boost it by providing more power. Once the droid made contact with the cruiser, Zettifar transmitted a message about the situation on the station. The medical cruiser assessed the situation and transmitted the results of its scan. The padawan was shocked at the damage to the station and learned that it was slowly falling out of orbit. After looking closer at the scan provided by the Eiram, Zettifar determined that the maintenance shafts could be used to travel to other parts of the station. Zettifar and Agaburry made their way back to the main docking bay, where they rejoined the other Jedi. [[Elzar Mann]] sent Zettifar and Agaburry to help calm the crowd in the docking bay. As they did, the station suffered some structural failure, which caused Zettifar to lose his footing. As he steadied himself against a wall, he could feel heat emanating from it. He realized that there was a problem with the auxiliary power and reported it to the rest of the Jedi. [[Stellan Gios]] instructed him and Agaburry to assist with the repairs. As it became more apparent that the station was going to tear in half, Zettifar vowed to return to the medical tower so he could be with Ember and Stokes. Zettifar returned to the docking bay to calm the passenger trapped there and to check on the status of the medical tower. He returned to work on the auxiliary power systems and managed to get them stabilized. Agaburry suggested they go look for [[Orla Jareni]] and they went to the cargo bay. He discovered her desiccated corpse on the deck and commed Gios with the bad news. The Jedi Master directed Zettifar to put up a containment field around the remains. Zettifar and Agaburry realized that Assek had also been investigating the Force disturbance and continued to search for her. They soon found her husked remains in the cargo bay. Zettifar comforted his friend who was distraught over the loss of his master. The two padawans returned to the [[quartermaster's office]] and informed Mann about the deaths of the two Jedi Masters. He quickly came up with a plan of action and ordered the padawans to find non-Force users to assist with blocking off parts of the station to prevent the threat from reaching the rest of the Jedi. Zettifar led a group of people to the [[airlock]]s and showed them how to manually close them. As he worked, he came up with an idea that would allow some of the people trapped on the station to flee. He proposed that people board the ships in the cargo bay and then force open the doors. With the area sealed off, the explosive decompression would be lessened and the ships could then safely depart the station. To prep for the plan, Zettifar checked the cargo manifests to make sure all excess items could be dumped to increase space for passengers. He came upon several ships that were described as carrying live [[rathtar]]s. He was checking the ships and inadvertently released several of the creatures. [[File:BurryagaElzarRathtar.jpg|thumb|250px|Burryaga Agaburry fights the rathtars]] Zettifar drew his [[Bell Zettifar's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and started to attack the rathtars, but was blocked by Agaburry. The Wookiee informed him that the creatures reproduced by fission so it was prudent not to slice them in half. Zettifar was able to stab one through its body, killing it. The rathtars were distracted by an emergency flare and Zettifar and the others were able to flee the cargo bay, sealing it behind them. He returned to the quartermaster's office and reported to the Jedi. He also explained his plan for getting some of the passengers off of Starlight Beacon. Gios ordered him to return to the medical tower to assess the situation there and come up with a plan to rescue the patients. He made his way back to the medical tower and checked on Ember and Stokes. He then worked on the problem of saving the patients stuck in the medical tower. He realized that if he could separate the tower from Starlight Beacon, the medical cruiser would be able to catch it in a tractor beam and dock with it using one of the internal air locks that would then be accessible. He contracted Gios and detailed his plan. The Jedi Master thought about how Zettifar had matured during this crisis and predicted he would become a great Jedi Knight. After clearing his plan with Gios, Zettifar constructed a crude bomb and planted at the base of the medical tower and sealed the air locks. The detonation blew the tower clear of Starlight Beacon. As the Eiram moved the tower clear of the station, Zettifar felt the Force returning to him and wondered how the remaining Jedi could cope with the limitations they were experiencing. After confirmed everyone was safe, he called back to the Starlight Beacon to see if he could be of any more assistance. Gios congratulated him on ingenuity but regretfully informed him that Agaburry was presumed dead after being attacked by a pair of rathtar in the cargo bay. Zettifar took a [[shuttle]] from the Eiram medical cruiser and headed back to the station, determined to help in any way possible. As he got close, he started to be affected by the Nameless and managed to pull away from the station. He realized if he went back onboard, he would become ineffective. He reached out to the station, and got in touch with [[Affie Hollow]] who was working on restoring the [[escape pod]]s. She asked him to visually confirm the escape pods would not be damaged when launching. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Zettifar landed on Eiram and assisted the Jedi with doing the final repairs on the [[desalination plant]]. He returned to the shuttle and went to search for Agaburry, refusing to believe he was dead. ====Search for Burryaga==== When the call came for the Jedi to regroup on Coruscant following the destruction of Starlight Beacon and the establishment of the [[Occlusion Zone]], Zettifar opted instead to stay behind and look for his friend. Zettifar petitioned Eiram's Administrator [[Gorta (individual)|Gorta]] for resources to help find Agaburry. Gorta denied the request citing the necessity of resources in the recovery efforts and the growing unpopularity of the Jedi on the planet after the destruction of Starlight Beacon. Zettifar instead joined a fishing crew aboard the ''[[Queen Xiri]]'' in order to scout the ocean for signs of Agaburry. While aboard he heard rumors from another crew of totems made of driftwood and fur that washed up on [[Pastor's Shore]]. Piloting a [[submarine]], Zettifar found Agaburry in an underwater cave and rescued him. ====Jedi Knight==== Two months after the fall of Starlight Beacon, Zettifar was [[Knighting Ceremony|knighted]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] alongside Agaburry.[[The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 3|''The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight'' 3]] Zettifar attempted to find clues about the leader of the Nihil, Marchion Ro. Believing that Zettifar needed a task to focus on, [[Jedi Council]] member [[Pra-Tre Veter]] assigned him to a [[Jedi-Republic task force|task force]] to fight the Nihil near the [[Stormwall]] on the borders of the Occlusion Zone. Nine months after the fall of Starlight Beacon, Zettifar attended a meeting aboard the [[Emissary-class Republic Cruiser|''Emissary''-class Cruiser]] ''[[Third Horizon]]'' led by [[Admiral]] [[Pevel Kronara]], regarding a Nihil attack on a settlement on [[Asternin]]. Kronara asked the Jedi to deliver aid to the planet. Veter, Zettifar, and Agaburry met with the settlement's mayor, but they were spotted by Nihil scouts. A Nihil [[Stormship]], the ''[[Cacophony]]'', destroyed the ship the Jedi had used and activated its [[47 lightsaber nullifier]], deactivating the Jedi's weapons. On Veter's insistence, Zettifar and Agaburry rounded up the townspeople and fled while the [[Grand Master]] fought the Nihil. Nearly a year after the fall of Starlight, Zettifar and Agaburry were patrolling the border of the Occlusion Zone on the ''[[Tractate]]'' when they received a distress signal from the planet [[Ribento]], which was being [[Bombardment of Ribento|bombarded]] by Nihil ships, including the ''Cacophony''. [[Melis Shryke]] launched two [[drill ship]]s that tore into the ''Tractate'''s hull and delivered [[Security droid|enforcer droids]] into the ship. Zettifar and Agaburry split up to fight the droids. [[Republic Defense Coalition]] reinforcements arrived, but the ''Cacophony'' escaped.''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]'' Later, Zettifar and Agaburry arrived on the planet [[Phrill]] with relief ships from the RDC to lend aid to the town of [[Perseverance (town)|Perseverance]], which had been destroyed by Shryke's Nihil forces. Agaburry sensed people trapped under a collapsed building, and the two Jedi worked together to free them. At the RDC base on [[Hintis IV]], Zettifar and Agaburry studied a map of places where Nihil ships had exited the Stormwall, unable to determine a pattern to predict their emergence. The ''Tractate'''s captain, [[Amaryl Pel]], informed them that the ship had been sufficiently repaired to resume service. At the behest of Elzar Mann, a fleet of RDC and Jedi ships, including the ''Tractate'', assembled at the border of the Occlusion Zone to [[Assault on the Stormwall|attempt to pierce the Stormwall]]. The assault destroyed several of the [[stormseed]]s making up the wall, but as some of the Republic vessels tried to move through the breach, the Stormwall repaired itself and the ships were destroyed. Zettifar felt the deaths through the Force and resolved to find a way through the Stormwall. After the failed attack on the Stormwall, the ''Tractate'' resumed its patrol of the Occlusion Zone's border. The ship's crew noticed that [[Expansion of the Stormwall|the Stormwall was expanding]], and Captain Pel gave the order to get clear of it so that they would not be trapped in the Occlusion Zone. Zettifar took the ship's controls and attempted to take them toward the approaching Stormwall, hoping for a chance to take the fight to the Nihil, but Agaburry talked him down and the ''Tractate'' made its escape. At the Hintis IV base, Zettifar and Agaburry spoke with the technician [[Harlak]] about the seemingly random locations of raids carried out by the Nihil. Agaburry came up with the idea to analyze the locations of the ''Cacophony'''s raids specifically. Harlak identified a pattern to Melis Shryke's attacks and predicted that the ''Cacophony'''s next emergence from the Stormwall could be near a planet called [[Reventine]]. The ''Tractate'' waited with a large force of RDC ships for the ''Cacophony'' near the point where it was predicted to appear in the [[Seswenna sector]]. The ''Cacophony'' emerged from the Stormwall badly damaged. Zettifar hailed the Nihil ship, warning Melis Shryke that she was surrounded, but to his surprise, Jedi Master [[Avar Kriss]], who had been trapped in the Occlusion Zone, answered the hail, informing the ''Tractate'''s crew that she had Shryke as a prisoner. When Kriss returned to Coruscant, Zettifar was among the Jedi to welcome her back. ===Encounters with the Drengir=== Months later, Zettifar and Agaburry traveled to the planet [[Oanne]] near the border of the Occlusion Zone, where they tried to convince the inhabitants to evacuate the planet due to the risk of it being claimed by another expansion of the Stormwall. The [[Elia-An]] were reluctant to leave since they relied on their planet's [[nativity tree]]s to reproduce. The Jedi were interrupted by a message informing them that the Drengir had been sighted in a neighboring [[star system]].''[[The High Republic: Temptation of the Force]]'' Zettifar and Agaburry traveled aboard the ''Tractate'' to the reported location of the Drengir, [[Felne 6]]. The two Jedi and Ember located the Drengir, but Agaburry, [[Telepathy|sensing]] the Drengir through the Force, stopped Zettifar from attacking, realizing it was dying. Agaburry held vigil for the Drengir, and suggested to Zettifar that they investigate any other Drengir appearances nearby, as he was troubled by the emotions he had sensed from it. Zettifar and Agaburry investigated a potential Drengir sighting on [[Ronaphaven]]. They found what appeared to be an abandoned Drengir lair, but agreed this made little sense, as they had never heard of Drengir leaving a place before they have eaten all they can. Agaburry reached out with the Force and located a sensation somewhat reminiscent of the dying Drengir, and they arrived to find a section of prairie [[Blight|turned into pale stone]]. ===Battles with the Nihil=== Zettifar and Agaburry joined Avar Kriss on the ''[[Axiom]]'' to cross the Stormwall and [[Assault on Naboo|liberate]] [[Naboo]] from the Nihil. During the hyperspace journey, the two Knights approached Kriss and told her about their recent encounters with the Drengir. They speculated about whether the [[Great Progenitor]] could still be alive. On Naboo, Zettifar was part of the [[Drift]] of Vectors led by Kriss against the Nihil forces. Kriss instructed Zettifar, Agaburry, and [[Vernestra Rwoh]] to investigate the [[San Tekka compound]], where General [[Abediah Viess|Viess]] of the Nihil was reported to be. The three Knights landed at the compound and encountered two members of the manor's staff, who told them that Viess and two Nameless were inside. The Jedi entered, dealing with Nihil resistance, until they ran into the Nameless. [[Cair San Tekka]], who was escaping Viess's captivity, ran into the three Jedi as they were struggling with the effects of the Nameless. He pulled Rwoh away helped her fire at the Nameless with blasters. Meanwhile, Agaburry managed to throw his lightsaber at one of the Nameless. Both creatures were left dead. Agaburry told Zettifar to stay and secure the Nameless bodies while he, Rwoh, and San Tekka went to find Viess. The Republic won the battle after reinforcements arrived, but General Viess escaped. Afterward, Zettifar and the other Jedi recuperated in the San Tekka manor, Zettifar sleeping with his head on Agaburry's shoulder. Later, the Jedi returned to Republic space. Zettifar and Agaburry returned to Oanne, though both were struggling with the aftermath of their encounter with the Nameless, on the request of the [[Medicine artist|local leader]] [[Arryssslesh]]. She explained something was devastating their nativity forests, and showed them to a vast area of forest that had been destroyed by the blight. Agaburry meditated and managed to stop the spread of the blight using the Force, but only in a small area around him while expending much of his energy. Agaburry wanted to keep trying, but Zettifar convinced him that they would do more good by reporting what they'd found. Zettifar and Agaburry were summoned for a mission by Avar Kriss. They joined her along with Vernestra Rwoh, Jedi Master [[Mirro Lox]], and Lox's Padawan [[Amadeo Azzazzo]]. As they waited for Elzar Mann, Zettifar told the others about how Agaburry had managed to slightly hold back the blight using the Force. The Jedi met Mann on the ''Axiom'', where he explained that Marchion Ro had apparently been tracking the blight. They speculated on the connection between the blight and the Drengir, and reasoned that Ro's probable next destination was [[Vixoseph I]]. Arriving at the planet, the Jedi discovered Ro's flagship, the ''[[Gaze Electric]]'', but it soon jumped away. They decided to look for the blight and the Drengir on the planet, and learned that some ships had recently landed and not yet left. Zettifar and the other Jedi approached the planet in Vectors. As Rwoh and Lox continued to investigate from the air, the other Jedi landed and inspected the blight. As Rwoh alerted them that they'd located a Nihil [[gunship]], the Jedi on the ground saw a huge figure walking across the blight towards them, which they realized was a Nameless. Agaburry told Zettifar to retreat to the Vectors while he, Kriss, and Mann confronted the Nameless. After the Nameless was killed and the battle had ended, Rwoh took Zettifar and Agaburry to a calcifying Drengir and told them that she had seen Marchion Ro infect it with the blight. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Bell_Zettifar.png|thumb|200px|Bell Zettifar in Phase I of ''The High Republic'']] Bell Zettifar was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project, a narrative initiative to explore the Jedi [[Standard century|centuries]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. He first appeared in the initial release of ''High Republic'' media, simultaneously debuting in the novel [[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi|''Light of the Jedi'']] by [[Charles Soule]] as well as the young readers book [[The High Republic: The Great Jedi Rescue|''The Great Jedi Rescue'']] by [[Cavan Scott]] on [[January 5]], [[2021]].{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/622991/star-wars-light-of-the-jedi-the-high-republic-by-charles-soule/9780593157718|text=Star Wars: Light of the Jedi (The High Republic)}}{{Disney|subdomain=books|url=book/the-high-republic-the-great-jedi-rescue|text=The Great Jedi Rescue}} Zettifar was first revealed to the public ahead of the initiative's release on [[October 21]], [[2020]] in a [[StarWars.com]] article that gave an overview of some of the Jedi Padawans that would be introduced in the upcoming project. '''Omega''' was an enhanced [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Cloning|clone]], created from the [[Clone template|genetic template]] of the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], who lived in the [[Standard year|years]] following the [[Clone Wars]]. Originally created as a pure genetic replication of Fett, she was a medical assistant to [[Kaminoan]] [[Chief Medical Scientist]] [[Nala Se]] and spent her [[Standard day|days]] working in [[Tipoca City]] on the clone [[Planet|homeworld]] of [[Kamino]]. Omega witnessed many clones, including [[Hunter]], [[Wrecker]], [[Tech]], [[Echo]], and [[Crosshair]] of [[Clone Force 99]], a [[squad]] of [[clone commando]]s with genetic mutations that were also known as the Bad Batch. When the war ended in [[19 BBY]], Clone Force 99 returned to Kamino from a [[Battle of Kaller|battle]] on the [[planet]] [[Kaller]] in the aftermath of [[Order 66]] and encountered the newly-created [[Galactic Empire]]. Omega recognized the squad and was determined to befriend them. Later, when [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] arrived on Kamino to assess the [[clone trooper]]s, Clone Force 99 rejected the Empire's new orders. Omega would join Clone Force 99 and escape Kamino, although Crosshair chose to stay behind and serve the new regime.

Omega accompanied Clone Force 99 on their subsequent visit to the clone deserter [[Cut Lawquane]] at his family's [[Lawquane's Farm|farm]] on the planet [[Saleucami]], which was her first time away from Kamino. There, she made friends with the Lawquane children, [[Shaeeah Lawquane|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane|Jek]], and helped secure the family's escape by delivering forged [[chain code]]s to them so they could board a [[transport]] offworld. Although Hunter wanted her to go along with the family on the [[Starship|ship]], wanting to Omega to grow up with a family instead of being looked after by a group of [[soldier]]s, Omega insisted on remaining with Clone Force 99.

After Omega drew the attention of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] during the Bad Batch's [[Chase on Pantora|supply run]] on the [[moon]] [[Pantora]], the group made their way to the planet [[Ord Mantell]] to locate the [[Information broker|informant]] named [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], a former associate of the [[Jedi]] during the war. The Bad Batch would begin working for Cid, first completing a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|mission]] on [[Ord Mantell]] in exchange for information on Shand as well as [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] before pulling a [[Mission to a droid decommissioning facility|job]] on the planet [[Corellia]]. Shortly after the latter mission, Omega met [[Captain]] [[Rex]], a former soldier in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and associate of the Bad Batch. When Rex realized that the group still had their [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]], he implored them to get them removed. Omega and the others would join him on the planet [[Bracca]] so the rest of the group could undergo a procedure inside a downed [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and get the chips removed. After Rex departed, the Batch was discovered by the Empire. After being pursued by Crosshair and his [[Elite Squad|forces]], Omega was eventually kidnapped by a third party: the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]]. She would eventually escape Bane when he landed at a [[Bora Vio cloning facility|cloning facility]] on the planet [[Bora Vio]] to collect his payment, and after evading Bane and the recently arrived Shand, she was rescued by the other members of the Bad Batch.

When Hunter was captured by the Empire on a [[Extraction on Daro|mission]] on the planet [[Daro]], Omega and the others returned to Kamino to rescue him. Omega assisted in freeing him from Crosshair and his squad, but when the Batch tried to flee, [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyers]] [[Attack on Kamino|bombarded]] Tipoca City, completely destroying it. The group, along with the [[medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]] and Crosshair, followed Omega through the [[Kamino tube system]] back to their [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|ship]], but when the elevator back to the [[secret landing platform]] was damaged, the group floated to the surface in cloning pods, guided through the debris by AZI-3. When the [[droid]] sacrificed the last of his power to save Omega, she dived into the [[water]] after him and nearly drowned before being saved by Crosshair. When the Batch offered Crosshair the chance to rejoin them and leave the Empire behind, he declined. Omega thanked him for saving her and reminded him that no matter what, he was still their brother as well as hers before leaving Kamino with her squad.

Omega would go on to become a skilled user of the [[Zygerrian energy bow]] and would accompany the Bad Batch on many jobs and adventures, including on the planets [[Serenno]], [[Serolonis]], [[Skara Nal]], and [[Kashyyyk]]. She and the squad would visit the planet [[Coruscant]] when Rex asked them to help [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]], who was fighting for the rights of all clone troopers in the [[Galactic Senate]]. With their help, Chuchi was able to expose the destruction of Tipoca City as an Imperial deed, but it only amounted to [[Darth Sidious|the Emperor]] manipulating the Senate into allowing for new military measures that did not benefit the clones. Furthermore, Echo departed from the squad, joining Rex's [[Clone Underground]]. Omega tearfully said goodbye to Echo, although he promised he would not be gone forever. Omega struggled with Echo's absence, and when the ''Marauder'' was hijacked and stolen on the planet [[Ipsidon]], the squad's tight-knit togetherness was further threatened. Omega grew frustrated with her brothers and their willingness to move on and accept change, although after an important conversation with Tech, she realized that they were all dealing with it in their own way.

Having cut ties with Cid, who had neglected them in their time of need on Ipsidon, the Bad Batch would work with the [[pirate]] [[Phee Genoa]], and Omega took an interest in her outlandish tales of adventure. They would eventually visit the remote paradise of [[Pabu island|Pabu]], an island community that lay peacefully off the Empire's radar. Although Hunter wanted to stay on the island permanently and give Omega a peaceful life, they would learn that Crosshair had become an Imperial [[prisoner]] following Echo's return with the intel. Echo presented them with Imperial information as well as the group receiving a transmission from Crosshair, who had momentarily escaped and warned them that the Empire was still hunting them. In fact, Omega specifically was still a person of interest to Imperial researcher [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]], who wanted to capture her to force Nala Se into working for the Empire's [[Advanced Science Division]] project at [[Tantiss Base]].

The Batch made a plan to rescue Crosshair, traveling to the planet [[Eriadu]] to locate Hemlock there and use him to find Crosshair. However, the [[Bombing of Raven's Peak|mission]] proved disastrous, as they only escaped Imperial capture when Tech sacrificed himself and fell to his death. The whole squad was heartbroken, and Omega was devastated. Their return to Ord Mantell was equally calamitous, as Cid had sold them out to the Empire. Omega would be [[Capture of Omega|captured]] and taken to Mount Tantiss where she would meet another female clone named [[Emerie Karr]]. On Mount Tantiss, Omega would be imprisoned and forced to be a lab assistant to Karr and Nala Se. Although Nala Se tried to protect Omega from involvement in her research by destroying her blood samples, eventually, her blood was tested and identified as of critical use for the Empire's [[Project Necromancer]], causing the Kaminoan to facilitate Omega's escape. With the help of Nala Se's [[datapad]], Omega rescued Crosshair, who had also been imprisoned and tested on, and together, the two narrowly escaped [[Mount Tantiss]] and eventually reunited with the Bad Batch.

Omega was overjoyed to be reunited with her squad, and while Crosshair's return initially caused some friction, he was welcomed back as well. Soon after her return, Omega learned from intel gathered by Rex's Clone Underground that she was still one of the Empire's highest-priority targets and was being pursued by [[Clone X trooper]]s due to her [[Midi-chlorian|M-count]] levels, which had been determined through the blood testing. Omega was forced to lay low on Pabu while the others gathered information on why the Empire was so determined to find her. After Hunter and Wrecker did a mission with Fennec Shand in exchange for information about M-count, the former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Asajj Ventress]] found them on Pabu to pass along the information they had sought, which was that M-count targets were potentially strong with [[the Force]]. Despite the rest of the squad being distrusting of the former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] agent, Omega wanted to trust her and underwent several tests to see if she was in tune with the Force, as Ventress had suggested. However, the tests proved inconclusive.

After Ventress left Pabu, Hunter decided that Omega and the squad should leave the island, not wanting the Empire to also discover them there. However, it was too late. As they prepared to leave, an Imperial [[division]] arrived, destroying the ''Marauder'' and ransacking the town from the top down. As Omega and the others hid, Omega decided that she would have to turn herself over to the Empire to prevent any more harm to the civilians of Pabu. She surrendered to CX-2, with Crosshair being tasked with planting a tracker on the assassin's ship. However, he failed to do so, and Omega was brought back to Tantiss without knowing that her brothers had no way to find her. Back at Tantiss, Doctor Hemlock introduced her to the other subjects in their experiment, several [[Force-sensitive]] children who were being kept in the [[Tantiss vault]]. At the same time that her brothers began an attack on Tantiss in an effort to free her, Omega plotted her own escape alongside her fellow child [[prisoner]]s. After aiding in the escape of the children and other imprisoned clones, Omega was briefly recaptured by Hemlock, though he was [[Death|killed]] as Hunter and Crosshair rescued her. After the escape from Tantiss, Omega and the rest of Clone Force 99 returned to Pabu, where they continued to live for many [[Standard year|years]]. At some point, Omega set out to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[pilot]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:TipocaCity-CC.png|thumb|left|250px|Omega's homeworld was the watery world of Kamino.]]
Created in the [[Nala Se's private lab|private laboratory]] of [[Kaminoan]] [[scientist]] [[Nala Se]] on the<ref name="Return to Kamino">{{TBB|Return to Kamino}}</ref> [[extragalactic]] [[planet]] [[Kamino]] in the [[star system]] of the [[Kamino system|same name]],<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Omega was an unmodified [[Cloning|clone]] created with enhancements from the [[DNA|genetic template]] of the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]].<ref name="Bounty Lost" /> One of the Kaminoan's best-kept secrets,<ref name="GAR" /> she was one of only two clones that were pure genetic copies of the original Fett template—the other being [[Boba Fett]] (Alpha)—though Omega was unaware of this until later on in her childhood.<ref name="Bounty Lost" /> Although she was a pure genetic copy, she was unlike Fett in that she was a [[Gender|female]]. Omega worked as a medical assistant to Nala Se,<ref name="Aftermath" /> the scientist who had enhanced her,<ref name="Dawn Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> enabling her to be present for the creation of [[Clone Force 99]] in Se's private laboratory. Although she was present to see their mutations enhanced, the [[clone commando]]s were soon sent to be with the other [[clone trooper]]s the Kaminoans had made, leaving Omega alone once more.<ref name="Return to Kamino" />

During the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Clone Force 99—who took to calling themselves "the Bad Batch"—and the other clone [[trooper]]s were sent across [[the galaxy]] to fight the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="The Bad Batch">{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}}</ref> while Omega remained on Kamino. Nevertheless, she remembered each member of the Bad Batch, namely [[Hunter]], [[Wrecker]], [[Tech]], and [[Crosshair]], even coming to learn that they had been joined by [[Echo|CT-1409]] "Echo,"<ref name="Aftermath" /> a [[cyborg]] [[Clone Corporal]] who joined the [[squad]] after the [[Battle of Anaxes]]<ref name="Unfinished Business">{{TCW|Unfinished Business (episode)}}</ref> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="TCW 704 Date">{{TCWcanondates|704}}</ref> However, she was never able to meet the Bad Batch throughout the course of the war. Stuck on Kamino, she did not feel like she fit in with the standard clone troopers who were stationed there.<ref name="Aftermath" />

===Rise of the Empire===
====Meeting the Bad Batch====
{{Quote|I like you. You don't fit in around here either.|Omega, to the Bad Batch|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
[[File:Bad_batch_trailer_highlights.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Omega meets Clone Force 99.]]
Omega finally had a chance to meet with the Bad Batch<ref name="Aftermath" /> in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Aftermath Date">"Aftermath" begins concurrently with [[Order 66]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]].</ref> when they returned to Kamino after the [[Battle of Kaller|Conquest of Kaller]], a conflict that had been suddenly ended by the execution of [[Order 66]] and the end of the Clone Wars. During the [[Proclamation of the New Order]], Omega stood by Nala Se's side and briefly made eye contact with the Bad Batch's leader, Hunter, only to vanish once he was distracted. Following the assembly, Omega approached the Bad Batch and introduced herself, addressing each member of the squad by name, much to their surprise. When they asked what she was doing on Kamino, Nala Se appeared and explained Omega's position as her medical assistant with a tendency to wander before leading her away.<ref name="Aftermath" />

[[File:OmegaDefendsBadBatch-Aftermath.png|thumb|left|300px|Omega demands an apology for the Bad Batch.]]
Determined to grow closer to the Bad Batch, Omega decided to sit with them in the mess hall, which Tech noted was something that had never happened before. Unaware of her true nature as a clone, Hunter asked where her parents were. Omega barely had time to respond when [[Unidentified clone trooper (cafeteria)|another clone trooper]] made a passing remark, taunting the group by referring to them as the "Sad Batch." Taking offense, Omega threw [[Foodstuff|food]] at the clone and demanded he apologize. Hunter tried to de-escalate the situation, but Wrecker threw an entire tray of food at the clone trooper and started a brawl. Omega later tried to claim responsibility for the incident when the Bad Batch were called in for punishment, but Hunter refused, giving her a warning to stay away from their squad to avoid getting herself into trouble.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Omega later stood by Nala Se's side as she and the Kaminoan [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] attempted to convince [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] to consider the Bad Batch as an asset to the new [[Galactic Empire]]. However, Tarkin was more concerned about the squad's tendencies to disregard orders, especially since they had failed to comply with Order 66. Though she failed to comprehend most of what she overheard, Omega got the impression that Tarkin did not trust clones. She tried to warn Hunter of this as the Bad Batch was about to depart on a [[Mission to Onderon (Clone Force 99)|mission]] to the<ref name="Aftermath" /> planet<ref name="Onderon">{{Databank|onderon|Onderon}}</ref> [[Onderon]], but he dismissed her concerns. Nonetheless, she insisted on joining them, suspecting that it was no longer safe on Kamino. Hunter replied that change took time to get used to before departing with his squad.<ref name="Aftermath" />

[[File:Shock-trooper-officer-attacks.png|thumb|right|250px|Omega is caught snooping in the Bad Batch's barracks]]
While the squad was gone, Omega was instructed by Nala Se to stay in the medical wing. However, she decided to ignore these instructions and instead, accompanied by her [[medical droid]] companion [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]], made her way to the squad's [[Bad Batch barracks|barracks]]. Omega looked around in awe at their gear, and although AZI-3 said that it was mostly worthless trinkets and scrap, Omega took interest it. AZI-3 reminded her that they should not have left the medical wing, but Omega told him that it was a research assignment, which excited the [[droid]]. She took a special interest in a photograph of the squad, but was eventually discovered by a force of [[Imperial shock trooper|clone shock troopers]] that had come to confiscate the squad's gear. She was incarcerated and given the designation [[Prisoner]] 0219 while being held in a prison cell. She would later be joined in the custody by the Bad Batch, who were imprisoned following their refusal to act on Admiral Tarkin's orders to take out members of the rebel cell known as the [[Partisans]], who were being led by the human [[Saw Gerrera]] on Onderon.<ref name="Aftermath" />

====Leaving home====
[[File:OmegaEscapeFromKamino-Aftermath.png|thumb|left|300px|Omega helping the Bad Batch fight Crosshair]]
Omega reminded them that she had warned them about Tarkin, but was surprised when Hunter told her that the squad had come back to help her. Omega reaffirmed her desire to go with them. However, Crosshair begins to dissent, accusing Hunter of being a poor leader for disobeying orders and for being "soft" for the way he acted on both Kaller and Onderon. After Hunter responded that Crosshair should focus on escape first and questioning his decision-making later, Crosshair angrily sat down. Omega then approached him and told the clone that she knew what he was going to do and asked him not to, also mentioning that it would not be his fault. Crosshair narrowed his eyes at her as shock troopers came to the cell and took him away.<ref name="Aftermath" />

As the remaining clones formulated an escape plan, Omega was tasked with sneaking out to deactivate the [[ray shield]] after Wrecker damaged a wall panel to allow her to escape the cell. The shock troopers eventually noticed that Omega was missing from the cell, but she then dropped down on them from the ceiling, recovering quickly to deactivate the ray shield and free the others, who incapacitated the troopers. As the group planned their next move, she told Hunter that their gear had been confiscated and was likely in the hangar, which they were able to recover. However, after the force geared up, Crosshair came to stop his former companions from leaving. He had been outfitted with new armor and had his [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]] effects magnified, forcing him to become loyal to the Empire. After a fight that involved Omega firing a [[DC-15A blaster carbine|blaster]] for the first time and shooting Crosshair's weapon, the group escaped on the Bad Batch's [[Starship|ship]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']].<ref name="Aftermath" />

As the group discussed their next move, Omega gave Wrecker his [[tooka doll]], [[Lula]], which she had rescued during the battle, which greatly pleased him. She then made her way to the [[cockpit]] to look out at [[Realspace|space]] for the first time. Eventually, the others moved to the cockpit as well, where Hunter let her sit, telling her to strap in as they made the jump to [[hyperspace]] en route to the [[Suolriep sector]].<ref name="Aftermath" /> Omega's escape proved problematic for the Kaminoans, who desired access to her unaltered genetic template.<ref name="Bounty Lost" /> After Nala Se informed Lama Su of Omega's escape, Lama Su ordered her to not tell the Empire of the development.<ref name="Aftermath" />

====The galaxy awaits====
{{Quote|What is this?''"<br />"''That would be dirt.''"<br />"''It's amazing.|Omega and Tech|<ref name="Cut and Run">{{TBB|Cut and Run}}</ref>}}
[[File:OmegaDiscoversDirt-CaR.png|thumb|right|250px|Omega experiences dirt for the first time.]]
Safely in hyperspace, Omega was amazed by the ship and explored every corner of it before falling asleep on the floor along with Wrecker. Deciding to visit an old ally, the group headed for<ref name="Cut and Run" /> the planet<ref name="Saleucami">{{Databank|saleucami|Saleucami}}</ref> [[Saleucami]] to visit [[Cut Lawquane]],<ref name="Cut and Run" /> a clone who had long since deserted the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Republic Army]].<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref> The ''Marauder'' landed a short distance away from [[Lawquane's Farm]] and the Bad Batch began to walk towards their homestead. When Omega walked out into the [[Star|sun]], she took her first steps into the rest of the galaxy beyond Kamino. She was in awe, having never experienced any environment besides the perpetual overcast of Kamino. She was fascinated with her new surroundings, using her hand to scoop up some up dirt, which she had never seen before, and laughing. As the group marched on, Omega continued to marvel at her surroundings, gazing in wonder at the [[plant]]s and [[Carrier butterfly|butterflies]]. When they reached the homestead, Hunter introduced Omega to Cut, his wife [[Suu Lawquane|Suu]], and his adopted children [[Shaeeah Lawquane|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane|Jek]], who took her outside to play while the others talked inside.<ref name="Cut and Run" />

[[File:NexuStalksOmega-CaR.png|thumb|left|250px|Omega unknowingly put herself in great danger.]]
Shaeeah and Jek showed Omega how to play catch with a ball, but Omega accidentally threw the ball beyond the fence. The two children told her not to worry about it and left the ball, going inside to pack, as the family was looking to leave Saleucami due to the growing Imperial presence. However, Omega decided to retrieve the ball herself, and, after traveling outside the perimeter fence, she drew the attention of a predatory [[nexu]]. Hunter and Suu came out to rescue her, chasing off the creature. When Hunter began to berate her for being irresponsible, Cut stepped in. As Omega tearfully apologized, Cut hugged her and told her she was safe, carrying her back inside. Eventually, Omega sat in the gunner's nest of the ''Marauder'' in sadness. Meanwhile, Hunter and Suu discussed the incident, with Suu telling Hunter that children always had a way of getting into trouble and that they needed help staying safe. When Cut joined them, Hunter asked if the Lawquanes would be willing to take Omega with them, saying that she needed a peaceful life and not one of risk and danger.<ref name="Cut and Run" />

Meanwhile, [[Echo]] and Tech worked on forging [[chain code]]s for the Lawquanes so they could leave Saleucami in safety. Omega overheard Tech and Echo discussing how they were going to get the data for the codes as well as the disks, and Tech decided that if they allowed the ''Marauder'' to be impounded at the spaceport, they would be able to sneak in and access the what they needed. However, they decided to go about the plan without telling Hunter first, only alerting the squad leader once the [[Clone impound vessel|impound vessel]] was already taking the ''Marauder'' away. When Tech did communicate to Hunter about the plan, Omega listened to Hunter's angry reaction, telling Tech that turning in their ship was not his idea of a good plan. Tech replied that he had the situation under control, but when Hunter told him that Omega was on the ship, Tech and Echo were both surprised and concerned. Omega waved at the two aghast clones and smiled, telling Tech that she thought it was a good plan.<ref name="Cut and Run" />

As the ''Marauder'' was placed in the [[Saleucami impound dock|impound dock]], a pair of clones boarded the vessel and searched it. Omega waited with Tech and Echo in a small space above the main cabin until they left. As Tech helped Omega down, Omega told them that the plan was working so far and asked how she could help. She was disappointed when Echo told her that she had experienced enough action so far and that they could handle it. She and Tech stayed together in the ship while Echo snuck in and stole chain codes for Tech to forge. When clone forces amassed near the ship, preventing Echo or Tech from passing the codes to Hunter, Wrecker, and the family, who had entered the spaceport and planned to pick them up before boarding the last [[shuttle]], Omega grabbed the codes and snuck out herself to deliver them, succeeding in bringing them to the group.<ref name="Cut and Run" />

====Choosing family====
{{Quote|I know I made a mistake, and I have a lot to learn, but you don't have to get rid of me. I left Kamino with you. This is where I wanna be.|Omega, to Hunter|<ref name="Cut and Run" />}}
[[File:TBB-1x02-Omega.png|thumb|right|290px|Omega did not want to leave the Bad Batch]]
However, when Omega noted that Tech had made an extra one, Hunter pulled her aside and told her that she would be going along with the family. Omega was shocked and asked if she had done something wrong, but Hunter just said that they could give her a happy and peaceful life that he and his squad could not. Omega protested that she wanted to stay with them, but Hunter told her it was for her own good before going to rendezvous with the rest of the Bad Batch, who had been discovered and were battling clone troopers in the impound dock. In sorrow, Omega went along through the gate with Cut and his family, whose forged passes were approved. As they were about to enter the spaceport, Omega stared longingly at the Bad Batch, who were battling Imperial forces as Echo attempted to free the ''Marauder'' from the magnetic [[Boot (technology)|boot]], which was preventing them from taking off. Suu gently asked if Omega was ready to go, but Omega then decided to disobey Hunter and follow the Bad Batch, returning to the ship on her own.<ref name="Cut and Run" />

[[File:CutAndRun.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Hunter and Omega after the skirmish]]
As Echo removed the magnetic clamps from the ''Marauder'', the squad prepared for takeoff. Wrecker asked Hunter where Omega was, unaware that Hunter had intended for her to go with the Lawquanes, but before he could explain, Omega shouted for them to wait as she scrambled towards the ship. She made it back onboard just in time and the squad lifted off and escaped. After the harrowing adventure, Omega approached Hunter on the ship and apologized for disobeying him, but also to reaffirm her desire to be among them. She said that she knew she had made a mistake when she had gone beyond the fence and put herself in danger, but said that one mistake did not mean that they had to get rid of her. Hunter replied that if it was what she wanted, then they would be glad to have her even if he still had much to learn about taking care of her.<ref name="Cut and Run" />

====Fitting in====
{{Quote|I'll go with you.''"<br />"''No, that thing could be dangerous.''"<br />"''I'm part of this squad now too, right?|Omega convinces Hunter to let her come with him to reclaim their capacitor|<ref name="Replacements">{{TBB|Replacements}}</ref>}}
After their escape from Saleucami, the group stayed on the move. They began to ration food as their supplies ran low. At one point, Omega was sitting on the floor looking at a [[datapad]] when Hunter passed out [[ration bar]]s. Omega offered hers to Wrecker when the bigger clone expressed his disappointment at the rationing, but Hunter reminded Wrecker that Omega did not even have a proper place to sleep. Just then, the ''Marauder'' dropped out of hyperspace due to the [[Capacitor|power capacitor]], with Tech stating that the ship was suffering from damage sustained on Saleucami. Wrecker helped Omega strap in as the shuttle crashed on the [[Ordo Moon]].<ref name="Replacements" />

Omega remained in the cockpit as Echo and Tech went outside to replace the ship's [[capacitor]]. When they returned, they reported that the hull was being damaged by something outside. Omega saw a [[Ordo Moon Dragon|creature]] outside, and she yelled for the others to look. Tech deduced that the creature was an Ordo Moon Dragon, which fed on raw energy, and Echo checked the diagnostics and confirmed that the capacitor had been stolen. As Hunter prepared to go retrieve the device, Omega volunteered to come with him. Although he initially declined Omega's offer to join him, he relented and the pair donned [[breath mask]]s and set off after the creature.<ref name="Replacements" />

[[File:OmegaFindsSparky-Replacements.png|thumb|right|300px|Omega on the Ordo Moon.]]
Omega followed Hunter as he used his enhanced senses to track the creature. As they traveled, Omega told Hunter that Crosshair should not be blamed for his actions and that he was powerless to stop himself. Hunter merely responded by saying that he did not blame Crosshair, but instead blamed himself. He eventually located the capacitor, but as Hunter tried to grab the part, the dragon attacked him and knocked off his breath mask. Omega grabbed his mask for him and put it back on his face, but not before Hunter fell unconscious. Omega contacted the others with a [[comlink]], but then decided to take Hunter's [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|blaster pistol]] and [[Glowrod|flashlight]] and set off down the tunnels where the dragon disappeared. After some crawling, she located its den and the capacitor. When she returned to the surface, Hunter was worried for her safety, but Omega proudly displayed the part and reassured him that she was fine and said that she had completed their mission. Back onboard the ship, Wrecker showed Omega [[Omega's Room|her new room]] he had set up for her in the gunner's nest. Omega expressed excitement and gratitude to Wrecker, telling the squad she had never had her own room before. Hunter then told her that she was now part of the squad.<ref name="Replacements" />

===Pursued by dangerous foes===
====Exploring Pantora====
{{Quote|Are you all right? You seem lost.''"<br/>"''I got separated from my friends.''"<br/>"''I can help with that. Not to worry. We'll find them.|Fennec Shand and Omega|<ref name="Cornered">{{TBB|Cornered}}</ref>}}
As the Bad Batch discussed their next move, Omega was puzzled as to why Hunter suggested they go to the uninhabited [[Idaflor]], saying that they should explore and reminding them that she has never seen the galaxy like they had. After the group remembered they were out of rations and low on [[fuel]], Echo noted that he had overheard comm chatter that had their ship on the wanted list. The group decided to stop at the planet [[Pantora]] to resupply, which Omega was happy to visit and explore.<ref name="Cornered" />

[[File:Shand_and_Omega.png|thumb|left|335px|Omega initially trusted the deceitful Shand]]
Upon landing, Wrecker and Tech stayed behind to scramble the ship's signature and refuel, while Omega joined Hunter and Echo on a quick supply run. As they made their way around [[Ro Station]], Omega was again fascinated by a great variety of things she had never seen before. Noticing the citizens celebrating, she asked what they were doing, and Hunter said that they were celebrating the end of the war. As Hunter bartered with a [[Unidentified Gran trader|trader]], Omega looked at a [[clone trooper doll]] in the store. After she knocked over a container of them and was reprimanded by the merchant, she picked one up and showed it to Echo. When Hunter called Echo over to discuss selling him to the trader, who thought Echo was a droid due to his disguise, Omega noticed several [[voorpak]]s being transported along the street. She ran over to them, but as she was petting them, one of them grabbed the doll out of her hands with its mouth, causing Omega to chase after them. However, she quickly became lost, and in a very unfamiliar environment, was frightened until a woman approached her. Unaware that the newcomer was a [[bounty hunter]] named [[Fennec Shand]],<ref name="Cornered" /> who had been hired by [[Nala Se]] to capture her and bring her back to Kamino,<ref name="Bounty Lost" /> Omega gratefully accepted her help as Shand feigned compassion and promised to help her find her friends.<ref name="Cornered" />

As they walked, Shand asked Omega if she was hungry. Omega said that she was, and Shand proceeded to swipe two fruits from a nearby stand. Omega pointed out that she had not paid for the fruit, but Shand smiled and said that it was alright to break the rules sometimes. Omega, noticing that her new companion was armed, asked if Shand was a soldier, but Shand merely said that the galaxy was a dangerous place to be alone in. Omega agreed, saying that she was glad to have her squad to help look after her.<ref name="Cornered" />

Hunter, having deceived the merchant and made 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] by selling Echo, eventually realized Omega was missing and after searching, located her walking with Shand. Sensing danger, he engaged Shand, telling Omega to run before he was head-butted and stunned. Shand gave chase, and as Omega made it into the maintenance tunnels, she ran in to Wrecker, whom Hunter had dispatched to locate her. When Shand caught up, Omega climbed a ladder to the surface as Wrecker fought Shand. However, Wrecker was quickly defeated, and as Omega found herself on a tower next to heavy speeder traffic, Shand had her cornered. As Omega ended up hanging off of the tower, Tech directed Hunter, who was riding a stolen [[speeder bike]], towards her. Shand caught Omega as she fell and dropped her onto a transport before jumping on herself. After a fight with Hunter, the [[ComfortRide passenger airspeeder|speeder]] Shand had commandeered was destroyed by Hunter's [[pyro denton explosive]], and Hunter grabbed Omega before the group met up back at the ship and left Pantora. Identifying Shand as a bounty hunter, the Bad Batch realized someone had hired Shand to capture Omega.<ref name="Cornered" />

====Searching for answers====
[[File:CidHome.png|thumb|right|275px|The Bad Batch meet Cid]]
In the aftermath of their ordeal with the bounty hunter, Echo suggested they go to an old informant trusted by the [[Jedi]], [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid]], to find out information on their pursuer. Onboard the ''Marauder'', Omega was given a [[Wrist comm|comm device]] and taught how to use it, which greatly excited her. Omega initially playfully used it to communicate to the squad despite being right next to them, but by the time they arrived on<ref name="Rampage">{{TBB|Rampage (episode)}}</ref> the planet<ref name="BMF 48">{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> [[Ord Mantell]] to find Cid, she had become more serious, reciting the rules she had been given: don't wander off, pay attention to her surroundings, and use the comlink to contact them if she got into trouble. The group walked through [[Ord Mantell City]] and soon entered a run-down [[Cid's Parlor|parlor]] in search of Cid, and while the squad was initially told to get lost by a [[Trandoshan]] woman, Omega deduced that the woman was actually Cid while the others discussed, an observation that Cid noticed and complemented.<ref name="Rampage" />

Hunter quickly agreed to carry out a mission to [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|rescue]] a child named [[Muchi]] from a group of [[Zygerrian]] [[Slavery|slavers]] on the other side of the planet. As they traveled there, Omega asked Echo about slavery. As Echo told her what it was, she frowned and said that she did not feel like that was right, to which Echo voiced his agreement. When they landed outside of [[Old Ord Mantell City]], where the slavers were based, Omega was excited for their new mission, and was thus dejected when Hunter told her to stay with the ship as the squad moved in. Omega sat in the ship's cockpit and played with her doll, coloring it to resemble the Bad Batch's armor. As she showed her work to [[Gonky (Clone Force 99)|Gonky]], she heard voices outside. She grabbed a backpack and escaped the ship as a pair of Zygerrians searched inside. Looking through a pair of [[macrobinoculars]], she realized that her companions had been captured.<ref name="Rampage" />

[[File:OmegaSneaking-Rampage.png|thumb|left|290px|Omega had to rescue her squad from the Zygerrians]]
Omega snuck around the Zygerrian's camp and quickly made a plan, unlocking a cage that housed a [[rancor]]. Although she was captured, she successfully set the beast loose, which caused havoc and gave Wrecker time to free the squad. Omega joined Echo in escorting the Zygerrians' three other prisoners, two [[Falleen]] and a human, away while Hunter, Wrecker, and Tech went after the rancor, whom they had realized was Muchi. As they helped the others escape, Omega claimed a [[Zygerrian energy bow]] off of the ground. Their mission successful, the team left to return to Cid, with Omega riding on top of Muchi. Once the rancor was taken away by<ref name="Rampage" /> [[majordomo]]<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> [[Bib Fortuna]], who was representing Muchi's owner,<ref name="Rampage" /> the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]]<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Cid paid Hunter what she owed the squad and informed him about Shand, understanding that there had to be a reason a bounty hunter like her was chasing them.<ref name="Rampage" />

====First job for Cid====
{{Quote|Take it easy, kid. I don't wanna hurt you, but I can't have you getting in the way.''"<br />"''You're the one in my way.|Rafa Martez and Omega|<ref name="Decommissioned">{{TBB|Decommissioned}}</ref>}}
After their successful mission, Omega practiced shooting with her new [[Omega's Zygerrian energy bow|bow]] in Cid's Parlor. Omega was proud to hit three out of twelve shots, which Echo said was just luck and that she needed to keep practicing. Omega was not strong enough to aim accurately on a consistent basis, and her efforts were not benefited by two other patrons, [[Ketch]] and [[Bolo]], who began [[gambling]] on her success. After missing two more times, Cid arrived, and after booting the two other aliens out of the parlor, briefed the group on their first [[Mission to a droid decommissioning facility|mission]] for her: stealing a [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|tactical droid]] head on<ref name="Decommissioned" /> the planet<ref name="Corellia">{{Databank|corellia|Corellia}}</ref> [[Corellia]], which had valuable information for Cid to sell.<ref name="Decommissioned" />

[[File:Omega_and_Rafa.jpg|thumb|right|290px|Omega stops Rafa Martez from escaping with the tactical droid head.]]
The group landed and infiltrated a facility that was scrapping battle droids. Once they snuck past the [[police droid]]s and got inside, Hunter stationed Omega and Wrecker as lookouts while he, Echo, and Tech moved in. Echo accessed a computer to discover that there was only one tactical droid inside, which Omega was able to spot on the conveyor belt. However, another individual disguised as a worker went in and stole the head. Omega alerted the others of this development before she found herself face-to-face with another person, [[Rafa Martez]]. Omega quickly drew her bow, causing Rafa to freeze and put her hands up. However, Rafa convinced her to lower the bow and talk it out, and when Omega did, Rafa knocked the bow out of her hands. The bow managed to discharge a single bolt that ruptured a steam pipe, alerting the facility workers to their presence. Rafa communicated with her sister [[Trace Martez|Trace]], who had the droid head, and as she went to meet up with her, Omega gave chase and told Hunter she was in pursuit. Meanwhile, the rest of the Bad Batch fought back against the police droids that began advancing on them.<ref name="Decommissioned" />

[[File:RafaOmegaHunter-Decommissioned.png|thumb|left|275px|Omega with Hunter and their new allies]]
Omega followed Rafa, who eventually got the head from Trace, but ended up losing it onto another conveyor belt. Omega and Trace raced for it, with Omega taking an alternate route that allowed her to reach it first. As she fled from Trace, Echo shut down the power and caused the conveyor belt to stop, which made Omega trip and lose the head. As she became pinned underneath debris, Trace swooped in and reclaimed the head. However, as Omega remained trapped and neared the edge of the conveyor that would tip her into a fire, Trace and Hunter came to save her.<ref name="Decommissioned" />

The two groups decided to join forces and attempt to escape the growing number of police droids together, with Trace and Tech using the tactical droid head to command the other droids that were going to be scrapped into an army to battle the police droids. Omega used her energy bow to fire on the droids, also using her comm to contact Wrecker to help them. However, as the group fled the building, the tactical droid head was destroyed. The groups parted ways, with Omega waving goodbye and telling the sisters that they could visit them on Ord Mantell.<ref name="Decommissioned" />

====Meeting Rex====
{{Quote|I've met many clones in my time, but never one like you.|Rex, upon meeting Omega|<ref name="Battle Scars">{{TBB|Battle Scars}}</ref>}}
The Bad Batch continued doing missions for Cid and earned enough credits to get by. Omega and Wrecker formed a tradition of purchasing and eating [[Mantell Mix]] after their missions. After a mission stealing a [[lizard]] from the [[Rhokai gang]], the pair went out for Mantell Mix as per usual, but when they returned, the former [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] was seated with the others at the bar. Omega curiously took a close look at Rex when introduced, recognizing that he was a first generation clone and telling him as much. Rex was confused on how she knew that, and Omega responded that she could tell by the lines on his face.<ref name="Battle Scars" />

As the group continued talking, Wrecker asked Tech for treatment for his headache, a problem that had been ailing him for some time. When Rex learned that the squad had not had their inhibitor chips removed, he quickly stood up and backed away, placing Omega behind him and putting his hand on his blaster. Omega was distressed when Rex said that the four clones were a danger to themselves and to her. Hunter eventually got Rex to calm down and agreed to Rex's plan to remove their chips. Omega and the others met Rex on the planet [[Bracca]].
